skills.description: Elastic response concerns recovery after unloading, while linear response concerns the shape of a stress-strain relationship.

skills.name: Determine 0.2 percent offset proof stress from a tensile curve
skills.description: Draw a line with the measured elastic slope starting at strain 0.002, and read the stress where it intersects the tensile curve.

skills.name: Estimate residual strain using a stated linear elastic unloading model
skills.description: For a specified uniaxial state with total strain epsilon and tensile stress sigma, subtract the recoverable strain sigma/E to estimate residual strain.

skills.name: Find ultimate tensile strength from peak load and original area
skills.description: Locate the maximum recorded tensile load and divide it by the original specimen area to obtain ultimate tensile strength.

skills.name: Compare nominal and current-area average stress using measured areas
skills.description: At a given tensile load, calculate nominal stress with the original area and current-area average stress with the measured current section.

skills.name: Distinguish modulus, yield strength, and tensile strength in property data
skills.description: Choose the property column that answers the question being asked: modulus describes elastic stress-to-strain response, yield strength describes a stated yielding criterion, and tensile strength identifies a peak engineering tensile stress..

skills.name: Replace ideal planar supports with their allowed reaction components
skills.description: Choose reaction unknowns from the motion an ideal support restrains.

skills.name: Replace an equal-and-opposite force couple with its signed moment
skills.description: Two equal, opposite, parallel forces on distinct lines have zero resultant force but a nonzero couple moment.

skills.name: Move a force to another point using an equivalent force-and-couple system
skills.description: To represent a force applied at A by the same force at B, add a couple equal to the original force moment about B.

skills.name: Solve reactions of a stable pin-and-roller beam under point loads
skills.description: For a straight horizontal beam with an ideal pin at one end and a vertical roller reaction at the other, calculate reactions from planar equilibrium.

skills.name: Solve the force and moment reactions of a planar cantilever
skills.description: An ideal fixed end can supply two force components and a moment reaction.

skills.name: Audit a proposed planar reaction solution using force and moment residuals
skills.description: Substitute proposed reactions into horizontal force balance, vertical force balance, and a moment balance.

skills.name: Detect unrestrained planar rigid-body motion from support geometry
skills.description: Inspect whether ideal support directions restrain both translations and rotation of a planar rigid body.

skills.name: Recognize when support reactions require deformation compatibility
skills.description: For a stable single planar rigid body, compare independent reaction unknowns with the available independent equilibrium equations.

skills.name: Recognize the conditions for an ideal two-force member
skills.description: An isolated member in static equilibrium with only two nonzero applied forces and no applied couple must have equal, opposite, collinear forces.

skills.name: Transfer a known joint force between separate member diagrams
skills.description: When two members interact through an ideal joint, represent the force on one member as equal and opposite to the force on the other.

skills.name: Calculate internal normal force, shear, and bending moment at one beam cut
skills.description: Cut a planar beam at a specified section away from a concentrated load or applied couple, and isolate either side.

skills.name: Label the reference frame of a robot position or direction
skills.description: Attach a frame label to coordinate values before combining them.

skills.name: Construct a rotation matrix from one frame’s axes expressed in another
skills.description: Form R_AB by placing the three unit axes of frame B, expressed in frame A, into its columns.

skills.name: Check whether a supplied matrix represents a proper 3D rotation
skills.description: Check that R transpose times R equals the identity and that the determinant is positive one.

skills.name: Apply translation to a point but not to a free displacement vector
skills.description: For a rigid coordinate conversion use p_A=R_AB p_B+t_AB for a point and d_A=R_AB d_B for a free displacement vector.

skills.name: Compose a chain of labeled rigid transforms in the correct order
skills.description: With T_AB mapping B coordinates into A coordinates, combine successive mappings as T_AC=T_AB T_BC.

skills.name: Invert a rigid transform while rotating its translation correctly
skills.description: For T_AB with rotation R and translation t, form T_BA using R transpose and translation minus R transpose times t.

skills.name: Count independent coordinates of an unconstrained serial joint chain
skills.description: For a fixed-base open chain of independent one-degree-of-freedom revolute or prismatic joints, count one configuration coordinate per joint.

skills.name: Specify joint order, zero references, signs, and units for a configuration
skills.description: Define a configuration vector by listing joint coordinates in a fixed order with their units, positive directions, and zero references.

skills.name: Distinguish joint configuration, task coordinates, and reachable workspace
skills.description: Joint coordinates describe the robot arrangement, while task coordinates describe the output specified for a job.

skills.name: Calculate position and orientation of an ideal two-revolute-link planar arm
skills.description: For link lengths L1 and L2, shoulder angle q1, and relative elbow angle q2, compute x=L1 cos(q1)+L2 cos(q1+q2) and y=L1 sin(q1)+L2 sin(q1+q2).

skills.name: Include a fixed tool offset after the final link transform
skills.description: When the tool frame is displaced from the last link frame, append the fixed link-to-tool transform to the chain.

skills.name: Check the geometric position reach of an unrestricted planar two-link arm
skills.description: For positive link lengths and unrestricted revolute angles, a target distance r from the base is reachable in position when abs(L1-L2) is at most r and r is at most L1+L2..

skills.name: Calculate both regular inverse-kinematic branches of a planar two-link arm
skills.description: For a reachable position, compute c2=(x*x+y*y-L1*L1-L2*L2)/(2*L1*L2) and q2=plus or minus acos(c2).

skills.name: Verify an inverse-kinematic candidate by forward substitution and joint limits
skills.description: Substitute a candidate configuration into the forward model and compare the output with the requested target using stated tolerances.

skills.name: Derive the Cartesian position Jacobian of a planar two-link arm
skills.description: Differentiate the two planar tip-position equations with respect to q1 and q2.

skills.name: Calculate instantaneous planar tip velocity from joint rates
skills.description: Evaluate the position Jacobian at the current configuration and multiply it by the joint-rate vector.

skills.name: Identify lost instantaneous motion directions at a planar arm singularity
skills.description: For the two-link position task, the Jacobian determinant is L1*L2*sin(q2).

skills.name: Transform one-dimensional motion between observers
skills.description: Re-express a position and velocity measured by one observer for a second observer moving at constant velocity along the same line.

skills.name: Choose the system for an energy balance
skills.description: Decide which objects are inside the system before an energy balance, so each interaction is counted once, either as work or as stored potential energy.

skills.name: Test when momentum conservation applies
skills.description: Decide whether a system's total momentum, or one component of it, is conserved during an event by checking the net external impulse.

skills.name: Check assumptions before a Bernoulli calculation
skills.description: Decide whether a flow is steady, incompressible, effectively frictionless and free of pumps or turbines along the chosen streamline before using Bernoulli's equation.

skills.name: Track sign conventions in a thermal energy balance
skills.description: Carry one stated heat and work sign convention through a multi-step thermal balance, and convert results between the two common conventions.

skills.name: Compare flux change mechanisms
skills.description: Identify whether an induced emf comes from a changing field, a changing area or a changing orientation, and estimate each contribution.

skills.name: Convert between time delay and phase shift
skills.description: Convert a time delay into a phase shift at a given frequency, and recognize that a fixed delay gives a phase shift that grows with frequency.

skills.name: Separate optical resolution and pixel sampling
skills.description: Decide whether a camera's smallest resolvable detail is set by its optics (diffraction blur) or by its pixel spacing.

skills.name: Find a Thevenin equivalent with a dependent source
skills.description: Find Vth and Rth when the network contains a dependent source, which cannot be switched off.

skills.name: Check superposition limits for power calculations
skills.description: Recognize that power cannot be found by adding the power from each source acting alone, and add currents or voltages first.

skills.name: Verify a circuit solution using independent balances
skills.description: Check a solved circuit with a balance not used to solve it: a loop's voltages, another node's currents, or the power supplied against the power absorbed.

skills.name: Determine a capacitor's initial and final voltage
skills.description: Find a capacitor's voltage just after a switching event and once the circuit has settled, before solving the transient between them.

skills.name: Interpret poles, damping and resonance from a second-order model
skills.description: Read the natural frequency, damping ratio and response type from a second-order model, and relate them to an RLC circuit's components.

skills.name: Choose a valid diode approximation
skills.description: Pick the simplest diode model, ideal switch, constant drop, drop plus resistance, or exponential, that is accurate enough for the circuit at hand.

skills.name: Check a switch's voltage and current limits
skills.description: Compare the worst-case voltage across and current through a transistor switch with its ratings, with margin, including spikes and temperature.

skills.name: Distinguish conduction loss and switching loss
skills.description: Separate the loss a switch dissipates while fully on from the loss during each transition, and see which dominates as frequency rises.

skills.name: Check an op-amp's input and output range
skills.description: Confirm that a circuit's input voltages stay within the op-amp's common-mode range and that its required output stays within the achievable swing.

skills.name: Convert ADC codes with a stated reference
skills.description: Convert between an ADC code and the input voltage using the converter's stated reference and code convention, and estimate the effect of reference error.

skills.name: Trace a high-current return loop
skills.description: Follow the path a high or fast current takes back to its source, and find the loop's area and which other circuits share it.

skills.name: Plan test points for diagnosing a board
skills.description: Choose and place a board's test points so the supplies, references and key signals needed to separate likely faults can be measured safely.

skills.name: Replace a distributed load with an equivalent resultant
skills.description: Replace a load spread along a beam with a single force equal to its total, acting at its centroid, for use in external equilibrium.

skills.name: Solve selected truss joints
skills.description: Find the forces in the members meeting at a truss joint by applying equilibrium at a joint with no more than two unknown member forces.

skills.name: Identify the limits of a uniaxial material model
skills.description: Decide whether properties from a uniaxial tensile test apply to a part, given its stress state, loading rate, temperature and material direction.

skills.name: Check effective-length assumptions in a buckling model
skills.description: Choose the effective-length factor from how a column's ends are really held, and check how much the buckling load depends on that choice.

skills.name: Distinguish nominal and peak stress
skills.description: Compute both the nominal stress on a net section and the peak stress at a notch, and decide which one a given check should use.

skills.name: Distinguish yielding from crack-driven failure
skills.description: For a part with a known crack, compare the stress that would cause yielding with the stress that would cause fast fracture, and say which comes first.

skills.name: Distinguish fibre-direction effects from isotropic response
skills.description: Compute a fibre composite's stiffness along and across its fibres and recognize when an isotropic formula would mislead.

skills.name: Relate processing choices to dimensional change
skills.description: Predict how a manufacturing process will change a part's dimensions, such as shrinkage, warping, quench distortion or stress-relief movement, and plan an allowance for it.

skills.name: Build a functional datum scheme
skills.description: Choose a part's primary, secondary and tertiary datums from how it mounts and works, and dimension its critical features from them.

skills.name: Calculate differential expansion between joined parts
skills.description: Calculate how much two joined parts of different materials change length relative to each other over a temperature range, and its effect on a fit or a fastened joint.

skills.name: Write a function with a clear input-output contract
skills.description: State what a function accepts, what it returns, its units and what it does with invalid input, and make the code keep that promise.

skills.name: Design a boundary-case test
skills.description: Pick test inputs at, just inside and just outside each boundary a function's specification states, and derive the expected results independently.

skills.name: Identify numerical cancellation
skills.description: Recognize when subtracting nearly equal floating-point numbers destroys significant digits, and rewrite the calculation to avoid it.

skills.name: Explain object ownership across a task boundary
skills.description: Decide which task owns data passed between threads or tasks, and whether it is copied, handed over or shared under a lock, so it is never freed or changed while another task uses it.

skills.name: Prevent train-test leakage
skills.description: Split data so no information from the test set reaches training, including through preprocessing, related samples or time order.

skills.name: Lorentz force on motor windings
skills.description: Sum the magnetic forces on current-carrying conductors in a motor air gap and convert them into shaft torque using the gap radius.

skills.name: Magnetic circuits, air gaps and magnet grades
skills.description: Treat iron, magnets and air gap as a magnetic circuit to estimate gap flux density, and compare ferrite and NdFeB grades and their demagnetization limits.

skills.name: Derive back-EMF from winding motion
skills.description: Derive the back-EMF of a rotating winding from motional EMF and show that it grows in proportion to shaft angular speed.

skills.name: Electromechanical power balance in a motor
skills.description: Split a motor's electrical input power into copper loss, iron and friction losses, and mechanical output, and use the balance to find efficiency.

skills.name: Brushed DC motor construction and commutation
skills.description: Explain how the stator field, armature windings, commutator and brushes keep torque in one direction as a brushed rotor turns.

skills.name: Model a brushed DC motor with torque and back-EMF constants
skills.description: Write the electrical and mechanical equations of a brushed DC motor using resistance, inductance, torque constant and back-EMF constant, and solve steady operating points.

skills.name: Torque constant, back-EMF constant and speed constant
skills.description: Show that the torque and back-EMF constants are equal in SI units and convert between Kt, Ke and an rpm-per-volt speed constant.

skills.name: Stall torque, stall current and no-load speed
skills.description: Calculate stall torque, stall current and no-load speed of a DC motor from supply voltage, winding resistance and its motor constants.

skills.name: DC motor torque-speed and current-torque lines
skills.description: Draw the linear torque-speed and current-torque lines of a DC motor and read speed and current at any load torque.

skills.name: Output power and efficiency across the load range
skills.description: Derive the parabolic output-power curve, show peak power at half stall torque, and locate the higher-speed peak-efficiency point including no-load losses.

skills.name: Two-node motor thermal model
skills.description: Model winding and housing temperatures with thermal resistances and time constants, including resistance rise with copper temperature, to predict safe current duration.

skills.name: Continuous versus peak ratings on a datasheet
skills.description: Read nominal, continuous, peak and stall values from a motor datasheet and explain why continuous torque is thermally limited while peak torque is time-limited.

skills.name: Electrical and mechanical motor time constants
skills.description: Calculate a motor's electrical L/R and mechanical time constants and explain which one limits current response and which limits speed response.

skills.name: Bring up a brushed gearmotor with an encoder
skills.description: Wire a brushed gearmotor to a driver and encoder, verify rotation direction against count sign, and command safe low-duty motion.

skills.name: Brushless DC motor operation and commutation
skills.description: Explain how a three-phase stator and permanent-magnet rotor produce torque when phase currents are switched electronically in step with rotor angle.

skills.name: Pole pairs and electrical versus mechanical angle
skills.description: Convert between mechanical and electrical angle and speed using pole-pair count, and relate slot-pole combinations to commutation frequency.

skills.name: Inrunner, outrunner and pancake motor geometry
skills.description: Compare inrunner, outrunner, pancake and gimbal motors and explain why torque grows with gap radius squared times stack length.

skills.name: Six-step commutation from Hall sensors
skills.description: Build the six-step commutation table that maps three Hall sensor states to the phase pair to energize for each rotation direction.

skills.name: Trapezoidal versus sinusoidal brushless drive
skills.description: Contrast six-step trapezoidal drive with sinusoidal phase currents and explain the resulting differences in torque ripple, noise and smoothness.

skills.name: KV rating and torque constant of brushless motors
skills.description: Convert a brushless motor's KV rating into an approximate torque constant and explain why low-KV motors suit high-torque robot joints.

skills.name: Clarke-Park transforms and field-oriented control
skills.description: Transform phase currents into rotor-aligned d-q coordinates and explain how regulating q-axis current with d near zero gives smooth torque at any angle.

skills.name: Choose and calibrate a brushless rotor encoder
skills.description: Choose Hall, incremental or on-axis magnetic encoders for a brushless joint, then record the electrical angle offset and verify smooth commutation.

skills.name: Configure and bring up a brushless joint driver
skills.description: Configure an ODrive- or moteus-class driver with motor parameters, current and velocity limits and encoder calibration, then command position over CAN.

skills.name: Stepper motor construction and step angle
skills.description: Explain how hybrid stepper rotor and stator teeth produce discrete detents and calculate step angle and steps per revolution.

skills.name: Microstepping and current-chopping stepper drivers
skills.description: Compare full, half and microstep current patterns, then set phase current, microstep mode and decay on a chopper driver fed STEP and DIR pulses.

skills.name: Stepper holding torque and pull-out curve
skills.description: Read holding torque and the pull-out torque curve and explain how winding inductance and supply voltage make torque fall with step rate.

skills.name: Stepper resonance, missed steps and acceleration ramps
skills.description: Diagnose resonance and missed steps, keep an open-loop stepper synchronized with ramps and torque margin, and judge when closed-loop steppers are warranted.

skills.name: Command a hobby PWM servo and know its limits
skills.description: Generate the 50 Hz, 1 to 2 millisecond servo pulse, and explain the internal potentiometer loop, deadband, stall current and lack of readback.

skills.name: Half-duplex serial servo bus protocols
skills.description: Decode Dynamixel and Feetech instruction and status packets, including IDs, addresses, lengths and checksums on a half-duplex TTL or RS-485 bus.

skills.name: Command and read a smart serial bus servo
skills.description: Send goal positions to a smart serial servo and read back position, velocity, load and temperature using a vendor SDK or raw packets.

skills.name: Assign servo IDs and configure control tables
skills.description: Assign unique IDs and baud rates, set angle, current and temperature limits, and distinguish persistent EEPROM fields from volatile RAM fields.

skills.name: Smart servo operating modes
skills.description: Choose among position, extended multi-turn, velocity, current and current-limited position modes for a smart servo and switch modes safely.

skills.name: Synchronized multi-servo reads and writes
skills.description: Use sync-write and bulk-read instructions to update many servos per cycle and compute the bus time budget at a given baud rate.

skills.name: Tune smart servo gains and motion profiles
skills.description: Adjust a smart servo's internal PID gains and profile velocity and acceleration to trade tracking stiffness against overshoot and noise.

skills.name: Select servos for a desktop arm
skills.description: Pick smart servos for each joint of a small arm by comparing gravity holding torque and required speed against rated stall torque with margin.

skills.name: Gear ratio trade-off between torque and speed
skills.description: Use a motor's torque-speed curve to show how a gear ratio trades output speed for torque and choose a ratio that hits a required operating point.

skills.name: Gear tooth terms, module and meshing rules
skills.description: Relate pitch diameter, tooth count, module and diametral pitch, state why meshing gears share module and pressure angle, and compute center distance.

skills.name: Involute profile, pressure angle and contact ratio
skills.description: Construct an involute from its base circle, explain constant velocity ratio, and compute contact ratio and minimum tooth count to avoid undercut.

skills.name: Split a high ratio across compound gear stages
skills.description: Design a compound gear train that reaches a target ratio with reasonable per-stage ratios and tooth counts, and justify the stage count.

skills.name: Multi-stage gear efficiency, forward and reverse
skills.description: Multiply per-stage mesh efficiencies for a train and estimate how efficiency drops when the output drives the input in reverse.

skills.name: Backlash causes, effects and reduction
skills.description: Explain how center-distance tolerance, tooth thickness and bearing play create backlash, how it harms control, and how split or preloaded gears reduce it.

skills.name: Choose a gear ratio for reflected inertia
skills.description: Compute the inertia-matching ratio for fastest acceleration and explain how high ratios inflate reflected rotor inertia during collisions.

skills.name: Backdrivability and reflected friction
skills.description: Predict whether a joint can be backdriven by hand from reverse efficiency, reflected friction and reflected inertia, and why backdrivability matters near people.

skills.name: Gear tooth strength and materials
skills.description: Estimate tooth bending stress with the Lewis equation and choose among steel, brass, acetal, nylon and printed gears for strength, wear and noise.

skills.name: Design and print plastic gears
skills.description: Generate involute gears in CAD, adjust clearance for printer tolerance, print them, and test a pair for smooth mesh and backlash.

skills.name: Spur versus helical gears
skills.description: Compare spur and helical gears for contact ratio, noise, load capacity and axial thrust, and decide where each belongs in a joint.

skills.name: Planetary gear kinematics
skills.description: Apply the Willis equation to a sun-planet-ring set and compute output speed and ratio for any choice of fixed, input and output members.

skills.name: Planetary tooth counts and assembly constraints
skills.description: Choose sun, planet and ring tooth counts that satisfy the coaxial and equal-spacing assembly conditions for a given number of planets.

skills.name: Cycloidal drive principle and ratio
skills.description: Explain how an eccentric cycloidal disc rolling inside ring pins produces a high single-stage ratio with many teeth sharing load.

skills.name: Strain wave gearing principle and trade-offs
skills.description: Compute strain wave gear ratio from flexspline and circular spline teeth, and describe its low backlash, nonlinear stiffness, hysteresis and ratcheting limit.

skills.name: Worm gears and self-locking
skills.description: Compute worm gear ratio and efficiency from lead angle and friction, and determine whether the drive self-locks against backdriving.

skills.name: Bevel and crossed-axis gearing
skills.description: Explain how bevel and miter gears turn motion through an angle and when crossed-axis gearing simplifies joint layout.

skills.name: Differential mechanisms for coupled two-axis joints
skills.description: Write the coupling matrix of a bevel differential that combines two motors into pitch and roll of one joint, and invert it for commands.

skills.name: Compare gearbox types for a robot joint
skills.description: Compare planetary, cycloidal, strain wave, worm and belt reductions on ratio, backlash, stiffness, backdrivability, mass and cost for a given joint.

skills.name: Timing belt drives: pitch, teeth and length
skills.description: Select a timing belt profile and pulley tooth counts for a ratio and calculate belt length and center distance with minimum wrap.

skills.name: Belt and cable tension, pretension and stiffness
skills.description: Set belt or cable pretension so the slack side never goes loose under load, and calculate the resulting transmission stiffness.

skills.name: Capstan equation and friction wraps
skills.description: Apply the capstan equation to relate tension on either side of a wrapped drum and find the wraps needed to prevent slip.

skills.name: Route cables over pulleys and through joints
skills.description: Route cables across rotating joints so path length stays constant or is compensated, keeping tension uniform and avoiding rubbing.

skills.name: Bowden cable transmission and friction losses
skills.description: Estimate tension loss in a Bowden cable from total bend angle using the capstan relation and judge when remote actuation is worthwhile.

skills.name: Tendon routing and coupling matrices
skills.description: Express tendon displacements as a matrix of pulley radii times joint angles and use its transpose to map tendon tensions to joint torques.

skills.name: Tendon and cable drive for fingers
skills.description: Design a tendon-driven finger with routing, Dyneema or steel tendons, pretension, return springs or antagonists, and remote motors sized for fingertip force.

skills.name: Lead screw torque, lead and self-locking
skills.description: Calculate the torque to raise and lower a load on a lead screw, its efficiency, and whether the screw self-locks.

skills.name: Ball screw efficiency, preload and critical speed
skills.description: Compare ball and lead screws on efficiency and backdrivability, and check a ball screw's critical speed and preload for an axis.

skills.name: Rack and pinion drives
skills.description: Convert pinion rotation to rack travel, compute linear force from pinion torque, and compare racks with belts for long strokes.

skills.name: Linear motors and voice-coil actuators
skills.description: Explain how voice-coil and linear motors produce force directly from current and where their stroke and force density suit robots.

skills.name: Select a linear actuator for a lift or gripper
skills.description: Choose lead screw, ball screw, rack, belt or packaged linear actuators for a torso lift or gripper, including guides that keep side loads off the screw.

skills.name: Joint friction model: Coulomb, viscous and stiction
skills.description: Model joint friction as Coulomb plus viscous terms with breakaway stiction, and add its torque to gravity and inertia loads.

skills.name: Build a joint torque profile over a motion
skills.description: Combine gravity, inertial and friction torques along a planned joint trajectory to get required torque and speed versus time.

skills.name: Duty cycle and RMS torque
skills.description: Describe a repeating duty cycle of moves, holds and rests, compute its RMS torque, and compare it with continuous rating since heating scales with torque squared.

skills.name: Check operating points against the speed-torque envelope
skills.description: Plot required torque-speed points through a gear ratio onto a motor's continuous and peak envelopes and identify any violation.

skills.name: Actuator safety margins and derating
skills.description: Choose torque, speed and thermal margins that cover model error, payload variation, ambient temperature and supply sag.

skills.name: Match a motor and gearbox to a joint requirement
skills.description: Iterate over candidate motors and ratios, checking input speed, gearbox torque rating, reflected inertia and efficiency to pick a pairing.

skills.name: Choose a motor technology for a joint
skills.description: Choose between brushed, brushless, stepper and smart servo actuation from torque density, control quality, feedback, cost and wiring effort.

skills.name: Size an actuator from joint load, speed and duty cycle
skills.description: Run the full sizing workflow for a joint: torque profile, RMS and peak torque, speed, margins, then select and verify a motor, gearbox and driver.

skills.name: Size wheel drive motors for a mobile base
skills.description: Compute wheel torque and speed from rolling resistance, slope, acceleration and wheel radius, then size motors and ratios for a mobile base.

skills.name: Actuator bus voltage, peak current and regeneration
skills.description: Choose a bus voltage that reaches required speed, sum simultaneous peak joint currents, and plan for regenerated energy that can overvoltage the bus.

skills.name: Compare holding and braking methods
skills.description: Compare self-locking gears, brakes, powered holding and shorted-winding dynamic braking by heat, power drawn and behavior on power loss.

skills.name: Select and integrate a spring-applied brake
skills.description: Select a spring-applied electromagnetic brake by holding torque, release voltage and response time, and wire it to engage on power loss.

skills.name: Passive gravity compensation with springs and counterweights
skills.description: Design a spring or counterweight mechanism that cancels a link's gravity torque over its range, reducing motor load and fall risk.

skills.name: Actuator failure modes and safe states
skills.description: List actuator failure modes such as driver fault, encoder loss, gear tooth breakage and overheating, and specify the safe joint state for each.

skills.name: Series stiffness of motor, gearbox and structure
skills.description: Combine motor shaft, gearbox, belt and link stiffnesses in series, reflecting them through ratios, to find overall joint stiffness.

skills.name: Transmission compliance and two-mass resonance
skills.description: Model a motor and load joined by a compliant transmission and compute the resonance frequency that limits control bandwidth.

skills.name: Series elastic actuator design
skills.description: Design a series elastic actuator by placing a calibrated spring between gearbox and load and measuring its deflection to sense and control force.

skills.name: Torque control of a series elastic actuator
skills.description: Close a torque loop on measured spring deflection, add motor-side velocity damping, and measure the achieved torque bandwidth.

skills.name: Variable stiffness actuators
skills.description: Explain antagonistic and mechanically adjustable variable stiffness actuators and when changing joint stiffness is worth the extra motor.

skills.name: Actuator transparency and impact mitigation
skills.description: Explain how low reflected inertia and friction make an actuator transparent, letting it sense contact and absorb impacts safely.

skills.name: Estimate joint torque from motor current
skills.description: Convert measured motor current to output torque through torque constant, ratio and efficiency, and add friction terms for a better estimate.

skills.name: Error sources in current-based torque estimates
skills.description: Quantify how friction, hot-magnet torque-constant drop, cogging and gear losses corrupt current-based torque estimates and how to compensate for each.

skills.name: Motor constant and torque per watt
skills.description: Compute the motor constant Km as torque per square root of copper loss and use it to compare motors for efficient sustained torque.

skills.name: Quasi-direct-drive actuator design
skills.description: Design a quasi-direct-drive actuator pairing a large-gap brushless motor with a low single-stage ratio for high torque, backdrivability and current-based force sensing.

skills.name: Build and test a quasi-direct-drive actuator
skills.description: Assemble a quasi-direct-drive actuator from motor, planetary stage, bearings and driver, then verify torque, backdrivability and temperature rise.

skills.name: Detect collisions from actuator current residuals
skills.description: Compare measured and model-predicted joint torques and trigger a stop when the residual exceeds a threshold tuned for false-alarm rate.

skills.name: Measure motor resistance, Kt and Ke on the bench
skills.description: Measure winding resistance, spin the motor to record back-EMF on an oscilloscope, and compute Ke and Kt with uncertainty.

skills.name: Build an actuator test rig with load and logging
skills.description: Mount an actuator against a known load, inertia or brake with logged current, position and temperature for repeatable tests.

skills.name: Identify joint friction from constant-speed tests
skills.description: Run constant-velocity sweeps in both directions and fit Coulomb and viscous friction coefficients from current by least squares.

skills.name: Measure a torque-speed curve with a dynamometer
skills.description: Load an actuator with a brake or second motor, sweep torque, and plot measured speed, current and efficiency against datasheet curves.

skills.name: Verify continuous torque with a thermal soak test
skills.description: Hold a constant load while logging winding or case temperature until steady state, and fit thermal resistance and time constant.

skills.name: Hydraulic actuator principles and power density
skills.description: Compute cylinder force and speed from pressure and flow and explain why hydraulics offer high power density but complex plumbing.

skills.name: Pneumatic cylinders and artificial muscles
skills.description: Calculate pneumatic cylinder force, explain why air compressibility softens position control, and describe how McKibben muscles contract in antagonistic pairs.

skills.name: Shape-memory alloy and electroactive actuators
skills.description: Explain how shape-memory alloy wires and electroactive polymers actuate, and compare their strain, force, speed and efficiency with motors.

skills.name: Tabulate humanoid joint torque and speed requirements
skills.description: Build a table of every humanoid upper-body joint with range, peak and continuous torque, speed and payload case derived from tasks.

skills.name: Place actuators proximally to cut distal inertia
skills.description: Quantify how moving motors toward the shoulder with belts or cables reduces arm inertia and the torque required at every proximal joint.

skills.name: Choose shoulder actuation for a humanoid arm
skills.description: Choose motors and reductions for a three-axis humanoid shoulder that carries the whole arm's gravity load while remaining safe to touch.

skills.name: Choose elbow actuation for a humanoid arm
skills.description: Choose an elbow actuator and placement, comparing an in-joint gearmotor with a belt or linkage driven from the upper arm.

skills.name: Choose wrist actuation for a humanoid arm
skills.description: Design a compact wrist using small servos, a differential or remote cable drive, trading size and mass against torque and backlash.

skills.name: Choose neck and head actuation for expressive motion
skills.description: Select quiet, smooth actuators for neck pan and tilt and facial mechanisms so head motion looks natural and supports gaze behavior.

skills.name: Choose finger actuation for a humanoid hand
skills.description: Compare in-finger micro servos, linkage-driven fingers, and forearm motors with tendons for grip force, dexterity, size and repairability.

skills.name: Choose waist and torso actuation
skills.description: Size waist rotation, torso pitch or a linear torso lift for large holding loads, including brakes so the torso stays put without power.

skills.name: Reduce actuator noise for human-facing robots
skills.description: Identify gear, commutation, PWM and fan noise sources and reduce them with helical gears, sinusoidal drive, higher PWM frequency and damping.

skills.name: Choose hip, knee and ankle actuation for a biped
skills.description: Estimate hip, knee and ankle torques for standing, squatting and walking, then choose quasi-direct, cycloidal, linear or parallel-spring leg actuators.

skills.name: Set up a Python machine learning environment
skills.description: Create an isolated Python environment with NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter and PyTorch, pin versions, and confirm whether a CUDA GPU is visible.

skills.name: Train, validation and test splits
skills.description: Split a dataset into training, validation and test sets, grouping by recording session or episode so near-duplicate robot samples never straddle a split.

skills.name: Encode categorical and missing features
skills.description: Convert raw columns into model-ready features using one-hot encoding, imputation of missing values, and pipelines that fit transforms on training data only.

skills.name: Softmax and cross-entropy loss
skills.description: Convert logits to class probabilities with softmax and compute cross-entropy loss, explaining it as negative log-likelihood of the correct label.

skills.name: Confusion matrix, precision, recall and F1
skills.description: Build a confusion matrix from predictions and compute precision, recall, F1 and per-class accuracy, choosing which error type matters for a robot task.

skills.name: ROC and precision-recall curves
skills.description: Sweep a decision threshold to draw ROC and precision-recall curves, compute their areas, and pick an operating point that meets a false-alarm limit.

skills.name: K-fold cross-validation and model selection
skills.description: Use k-fold and grouped cross-validation to compare models and tune hyperparameters with grid or random search without touching the test set.

skills.name: L1 and L2 regularization penalties
skills.description: Add L1 and L2 penalties to a loss, explain their effect on weights, sparsity and overfitting, and tune the penalty strength by validation.

skills.name: Learning curves and early stopping
skills.description: Plot training and validation loss against data size and epochs to diagnose bias versus variance, and stop training at the best validation point.

skills.name: Train and evaluate a supervised model
skills.description: Carry a supervised learning problem from raw data through features, model fitting, cross-validated tuning and a held-out test report with appropriate metrics.

skills.name: Logistic regression
skills.description: Fit a logistic regression classifier with gradient descent, interpret its sigmoid output as a probability, and read the decision boundary from its weights.

skills.name: K-nearest neighbors
skills.description: Classify and regress with k-nearest neighbors, choose k and the distance metric, and explain why feature scaling changes the result.

skills.name: Decision trees and impurity splits
skills.description: Grow a decision tree by choosing splits that reduce Gini impurity or entropy, limit depth to control overfitting, and extend to random forests.

skills.name: K-means clustering
skills.description: Cluster unlabeled data with k-means, choose the number of clusters with inertia or silhouette scores, and recognize when clusters are not spherical.

skills.name: Principal component analysis
skills.description: Reduce feature dimension with PCA computed from the covariance matrix or SVD, and choose components by explained variance.

skills.name: Perceptron and linear decision boundaries
skills.description: Train a single perceptron with the perceptron update rule and show why one linear unit cannot separate an XOR-style dataset.

skills.name: Multilayer perceptron forward pass
skills.description: Compute the forward pass of a multilayer perceptron in matrix form for a batch, tracking weight, bias and activation shapes at every layer.

skills.name: Activation functions
skills.description: Compare ReLU, sigmoid, tanh and GELU activations, compute their derivatives, and explain saturation and why nonlinearity is required for depth.

skills.name: Backpropagation
skills.description: Derive gradients through a small network by applying the chain rule backward over its computational graph, and check them against finite differences.

skills.name: Mini-batch stochastic gradient descent
skills.description: Train with shuffled mini-batches, relate batch size, epochs and iterations, and diagnose a learning rate that is too high or too low from the loss curve.

skills.name: Momentum, Adam and learning-rate schedules
skills.description: Explain momentum and Adam updates, configure weight decay, and apply warmup and cosine or step learning-rate schedules to stabilize training.

skills.name: Initialization and normalization layers
skills.description: Explain vanishing and exploding gradients, choose He or Xavier initialization, and use batch or layer normalization correctly in training and eval modes.

skills.name: Dropout and weight decay in networks
skills.description: Regularize a neural network with dropout and weight decay, and explain why dropout behaves differently at training and inference time.

skills.name: PyTorch tensors, shapes and broadcasting
skills.description: Create and manipulate PyTorch tensors, control dtype and device, reshape and index them, and predict broadcasting results before running code.

skills.name: PyTorch autograd
skills.description: Use autograd to compute gradients of tensor expressions, inspect grad fields, detach tensors, and disable gradient tracking during inference.

skills.name: Build models with nn.Module
skills.description: Define a network as an nn.Module subclass with layers and a forward method, count its parameters, and switch it between train and eval modes.

skills.name: Datasets and DataLoaders
skills.description: Write a custom Dataset that loads samples from disk and wrap it in a DataLoader with batching, shuffling, workers and per-sample transforms.

skills.name: Write a PyTorch training and validation loop
skills.description: Write a training loop that zeroes gradients, computes loss, steps the optimizer and logs metrics, plus a validation pass without gradients.

skills.name: Train on a CUDA GPU
skills.description: Move models and batches to a CUDA device, use automatic mixed precision, watch utilization and memory with nvidia-smi, and avoid host-device copy bottlenecks.

skills.name: Save, resume and version checkpoints
skills.description: Save model, optimizer and scheduler state with seeds and config, resume interrupted training exactly, and tag the checkpoint used for each result.

skills.name: Train a neural network in PyTorch
skills.description: Train a neural network end to end in PyTorch on a GPU with regularization, normalization, checkpoints and early stopping, and report validated results.

skills.name: Debug a failing training run
skills.description: Diagnose a training run that will not learn by overfitting one batch, checking label alignment, gradient norms, NaNs and learning rate.

skills.name: Estimate GPU memory for training and inference
skills.description: Estimate GPU memory from parameter count, precision, optimizer state, activations and batch size, and decide what fits on a 24 GB card.

skills.name: Set up a local multi-GPU training server
skills.description: Install NVIDIA drivers, CUDA and container runtime on a Linux GPU server, check interconnect and cooling, and share it safely between jobs.

skills.name: Data-parallel training across several GPUs
skills.description: Launch DistributedDataParallel training with torchrun across several GPUs, shard data per rank, use gradient accumulation, and measure scaling efficiency.

skills.name: Convolution layers: kernels, stride and padding
skills.description: Compute a 2D convolution by hand, predict output shapes from kernel size, stride, padding and channels, and count layer parameters.

skills.name: Pooling and receptive fields
skills.description: Apply max and average pooling and compute how the receptive field of a unit grows through stacked convolution and pooling layers.

skills.name: Convolutional neural networks
skills.description: Build and train a convolutional image classifier in PyTorch with augmentation, normalization and pooling, and inspect its errors on held-out images.

skills.name: Residual connections and CNN backbones
skills.description: Explain how residual connections let very deep networks train, and compare common backbones such as ResNet and MobileNet on accuracy and compute.

skills.name: Transfer learning with a pretrained backbone
skills.description: Adapt a pretrained image backbone to a new robot dataset by replacing the head, freezing early layers, and fine-tuning with a lower learning rate.

skills.name: Embeddings and vector similarity
skills.description: Represent tokens, images or sounds as learned embedding vectors and compare them with cosine similarity to find related items.

skills.name: Recurrent neural networks
skills.description: Process sequences with a recurrent network, unroll it through time for backpropagation, and explain why long dependencies are hard to learn.

skills.name: LSTM and GRU gated recurrent units
skills.description: Explain the gates of LSTM and GRU cells and train one on a time-series task such as predicting joint torque from recent sensor history.

skills.name: Scaled dot-product attention
skills.description: Compute scaled dot-product attention from query, key and value matrices, apply masking, and interpret attention weights as a soft lookup.

skills.name: Transformer architecture and attention
skills.description: Assemble a transformer block from multi-head attention, positional encoding, feed-forward layers, residuals and layer normalization, and train a small one.

skills.name: Vision transformers and patch embeddings
skills.description: Explain how a vision transformer splits an image into patch embeddings and compare its data needs and compute cost with a CNN.

skills.name: Contrastive learning and joint image-text embeddings
skills.description: Explain contrastive training of joint image-text embeddings in CLIP-style models and use one for zero-shot classification of camera images.

skills.name: Fine-tune a pretrained transformer
skills.description: Fine-tune a pretrained transformer on a small task dataset, choosing learning rate, epochs and evaluation to avoid catastrophic forgetting.

skills.name: LoRA and parameter-efficient fine-tuning
skills.description: Fine-tune a large model with LoRA low-rank adapters, pick rank and target layers, and compare memory and quality with full fine-tuning.

skills.name: Behavior cloning and covariate shift
skills.description: Treat demonstration data as supervised state-to-action learning, train a behavior cloning policy, and explain how compounding errors cause covariate shift.

skills.name: Digital audio: sample rate, bit depth and channels
skills.description: Explain PCM audio in terms of sample rate, bit depth, channels and frame size, and convert between common speech audio formats.

skills.name: Capture and play audio streams in code
skills.description: Record and play audio in Python through ALSA or PortAudio using callback buffers, choose block sizes, and detect dropouts and overruns.

skills.name: Short-time Fourier transform and spectrograms
skills.description: Compute a discrete Fourier transform of windowed audio frames to build a spectrogram, choosing window length and hop to trade time and frequency resolution.

skills.name: Mel spectrograms and MFCCs
skills.description: Convert a spectrogram to log-mel features and MFCCs, and explain why these perceptual features are the standard input to speech models.

skills.name: Voice activity detection
skills.description: Detect speech segments in a live audio stream with energy thresholds and a neural VAD, and tune padding and thresholds against false triggers.

skills.name: Wake word detection
skills.description: Train or configure a small keyword-spotting model for a wake word and measure false accepts per hour against missed activations.

skills.name: Noise suppression and acoustic echo cancellation
skills.description: Apply noise suppression and acoustic echo cancellation so the robot can hear a person while its own speaker is playing.

skills.name: How speech recognition models work
skills.description: Explain acoustic encoders, CTC and encoder-decoder speech recognition, and why models like Whisper generalize across accents and noise.

skills.name: Speech-to-text transcription
skills.description: Transcribe recorded and live speech locally with a Whisper-family model on GPU, choosing model size, language setting and segmenting with VAD.

skills.name: Measure word error rate
skills.description: Compute word error rate from substitutions, deletions and insertions against reference transcripts, and test recognition across speakers, distances and noise.

skills.name: Streaming speech recognition and endpointing
skills.description: Run speech recognition on a live stream that emits partial and final hypotheses and detects end of utterance with low added latency.

skills.name: Text-to-speech synthesis
skills.description: Synthesize speech with a local neural TTS model, normalize numbers and abbreviations, and choose a voice that fits the robot's persona and languages.

skills.name: Low-latency streaming speech synthesis
skills.description: Stream TTS output sentence by sentence as text arrives so first audio plays quickly, and measure time to first audio.

skills.name: Speaker identification with consent
skills.description: Enroll consenting users with speaker embeddings, verify identity against a threshold, and handle unknown speakers and opt-out deletion.

skills.name: Tokenization and token counts
skills.description: Explain byte-pair tokenization, count tokens for text in several languages, and see how tokenization affects cost, context use and odd model errors.

skills.name: Language modeling as next-token prediction
skills.description: Explain how a language model is trained to predict the next token, compute perplexity, and distinguish pretrained, instruction-tuned and chat models.

skills.name: Decoding, temperature and top-p sampling
skills.description: Compare greedy, temperature, top-k and top-p decoding on the next-token distribution and choose settings for factual answers versus varied small talk.

skills.name: Context windows and the KV cache
skills.description: Explain the context window limit, how the KV cache speeds generation, and how to budget tokens between system prompt, history and retrieved text.

skills.name: Call a cloud LLM API
skills.description: Call a hosted LLM through its API with message roles, streaming responses, error retries and API-key handling, and estimate cost per conversation.

skills.name: Prompt and configure a large language model
skills.description: Write system prompts, role instructions and few-shot examples that give a robot assistant a stable persona, scope and output format.

skills.name: Model quantization
skills.description: Explain 8-bit and 4-bit weight quantization formats such as GGUF and compare memory, speed and quality loss against full-precision models.

skills.name: Run a local LLM with llama.cpp or Ollama
skills.description: Run a quantized open-weight LLM locally with llama.cpp or Ollama, split it across GPUs, expose an HTTP endpoint, and measure tokens per second.

skills.name: Choose between local and cloud language models
skills.description: Decide when a robot should use a local or a cloud LLM by weighing latency, privacy, cost, connectivity, capability and offline fallback.

skills.name: Structured outputs with JSON schemas
skills.description: Constrain LLM responses to a JSON schema or grammar, validate them in code, and retry or fall back when output is malformed.

skills.name: Define a fixed robot skill library
skills.description: Specify a closed set of robot skills with typed parameters, preconditions, effects and safety limits that an AI layer is allowed to invoke.

skills.name: LLM tool calling to robot skills
skills.description: Expose robot skills as tools to an LLM, parse its tool calls, execute them through the skill library, and return results into the conversation.

skills.name: Vector search and embedding indexes
skills.description: Index text chunks as embeddings in a vector store and retrieve the nearest matches for a query, tuning chunk size and similarity threshold.

skills.name: Retrieval-augmented generation
skills.description: Combine retrieval with an LLM so answers draw on a curated document set, inserting sources into the prompt and citing them in replies.

skills.name: Hallucination and grounding checks
skills.description: Recognize LLM hallucination, require answers grounded in retrieved sources, and make the assistant say it does not know when evidence is missing.

skills.name: Etiquette and protocol knowledge base
skills.description: Build a sourced knowledge base of forms of address, greetings, titles and cultural customs, and retrieve it to guide polite, context-appropriate responses.

skills.name: Dialogue state tracking and slot filling
skills.description: Track user intent and required slots across turns in an explicit dialogue state, asking for missing details before a task can start.

skills.name: Conversation memory
skills.description: Keep short-term history within the context budget by summarizing, and store long-term user facts only with consent and an easy way to forget.

skills.name: Turn-taking and endpointing
skills.description: Decide when the user has finished speaking using silence, partial transcripts and prosody, avoiding both interruptions and awkward long pauses.

skills.name: Barge-in handling
skills.description: Let the user interrupt the robot mid-sentence by detecting speech during playback, stopping TTS within a set time, and resuming the dialogue cleanly.

skills.name: Conversational latency budget
skills.description: Break response latency into VAD, ASR, LLM first token, TTS first audio and playback stages, measure each, and meet a target turn gap.

skills.name: Dialogue management and turn-taking
skills.description: Integrate dialogue state, memory, tool calls, turn-taking and barge-in into one manager that runs a natural spoken conversation with a robot.

skills.name: Neural machine translation
skills.description: Translate text with a dedicated translation model or an LLM, preserve names and formality register, and evaluate quality with chrF and native-speaker review.

skills.name: Multilingual conversation
skills.description: Detect the spoken language, reply in that language with a matching TTS voice, and switch languages mid-conversation without losing dialogue state.

skills.name: Real-time interpretation between two people
skills.description: Act as a live interpreter between two speakers of different languages, managing turns, latency and uncertain phrases while keeping both parties informed.

skills.name: Symbolic planning with PDDL
skills.description: Model a task domain with states, actions, preconditions and effects in PDDL and solve it with an off-the-shelf planner.

skills.name: Behavior trees for robot tasks
skills.description: Compose robot tasks from behavior-tree sequences, fallbacks, conditions and actions, and compare their reactivity with finite-state machines.

skills.name: Generate behavior trees from language
skills.description: Translate a spoken instruction into a behavior tree built only from library skills, validating structure and parameters before execution.

skills.name: LLM task planning with verification
skills.description: Use an LLM to propose multi-step plans and check each against symbolic preconditions, skill limits and world state before any step runs.

skills.name: Execution monitoring and replanning
skills.description: Monitor skill outcomes during plan execution, detect failed or unexpected effects, and replan or ask the user for help instead of continuing blindly.

skills.name: Ground language references in the scene
skills.description: Resolve phrases such as the red cup on the left to specific perceived objects and 3D poses, asking a clarifying question when references are ambiguous.

skills.name: Open-vocabulary detection and segmentation
skills.description: Detect and segment objects named by free-text prompts using open-vocabulary detectors and promptable segmentation models, and measure their failure modes.

skills.name: Vision-language models and visual question answering
skills.description: Query a vision-language model about camera images, phrase questions that get reliable answers, and check answers against detections or depth.

skills.name: Action representations for learned policies
skills.description: Compare continuous, discretized-token and chunked action outputs for learned robot policies, and their effects on smoothness, latency and accuracy.

skills.name: Vision-language-action models
skills.description: Explain how vision-language-action models map images and instructions to robot actions, and run a pretrained VLA in simulation or on an arm.

skills.name: Fine-tune a VLA on robot demonstrations
skills.description: Collect teleoperated demonstrations and fine-tune a vision-language-action model with LoRA on a multi-GPU server, then evaluate success on held-out tasks.

skills.name: Markov decision processes
skills.description: Formulate a robot task as a Markov decision process with states, actions, transition probabilities, rewards and a discount factor.

skills.name: Value functions and the Bellman equation
skills.description: Define state and action value functions and write and evaluate the Bellman equations for a small known MDP.

skills.name: Value iteration and policy iteration
skills.description: Solve a gridworld MDP with value iteration and policy iteration and extract the greedy optimal policy from the converged values.

skills.name: Tabular Q-learning and exploration
skills.description: Learn action values from experience with tabular Q-learning, using epsilon-greedy exploration and tuning learning rate and discount.

skills.name: Reward design and reward hacking
skills.description: Design dense and sparse rewards for a robot task, apply shaping, and spot reward hacking where a policy scores well without doing the task.

skills.name: Reinforcement learning fundamentals
skills.description: Explain the agent-environment loop, exploration versus exploitation, and on-policy versus off-policy learning, and evaluate a trained agent's returns over seeds.

skills.name: Wrap a robot simulation as a Gymnasium environment
skills.description: Wrap a simulated robot as a Gymnasium environment with observation and action spaces, reset, step, termination and a reward function.

skills.name: Policy gradient methods
skills.description: Derive and implement REINFORCE with a baseline in PyTorch, and explain why policy gradients suit continuous robot actions.

skills.name: Actor-critic methods and PPO
skills.description: Train an actor-critic policy with proximal policy optimization, tuning clip range, advantage estimation and entropy bonus while watching learning curves.

skills.name: Train policies with massively parallel simulation
skills.description: Train a PPO policy with thousands of parallel GPU-simulated environments, checkpointing and comparing runs across seeds on a local GPU server.

skills.name: Domain randomization and sim-to-real transfer
skills.description: Randomize masses, friction, latency and sensor noise in simulation and evaluate whether a trained policy transfers safely to hardware.

skills.name: Export models to ONNX
skills.description: Export a trained PyTorch model to ONNX, run it with ONNX Runtime, and verify outputs match the original within tolerance.

skills.name: Set up an NVIDIA Jetson for inference
skills.description: Flash and configure an NVIDIA Jetson with JetPack, select power modes, monitor thermals, and run a GPU-accelerated model on it.

skills.name: Profile inference latency and throughput
skills.description: Measure model latency percentiles, throughput and memory with warmup and realistic batch sizes, and find the bottleneck stage in the pipeline.

skills.name: Optimize models with TensorRT
skills.description: Build TensorRT engines in FP16 and INT8 with calibration data, and confirm the speedup does not cost unacceptable accuracy.

skills.name: Deploy models on edge hardware
skills.description: Deploy optimized models on robot edge hardware within latency, memory, power and thermal limits, with versioned artifacts and a rollback path.

skills.name: Wrap a model as a ROS 2 inference node
skills.description: Package a model as a ROS 2 node that subscribes to sensor topics, runs inference at a set rate, and publishes timestamped results with confidence.

skills.name: Partition AI workloads across robot, server and cloud
skills.description: Allocate speech, language, vision and policy models between onboard computers, a local GPU server and cloud services to meet latency, privacy and outage needs.

skills.name: Build an evaluation suite for AI behavior
skills.description: Build repeatable test sets of scripted conversations and commands that score transcription, intent, tool choice and task success, and run them on every model change.

skills.name: Red-team AI behavior
skills.description: Probe the robot's AI with adversarial, ambiguous and unsafe requests, record failures, and turn each into a regression test.

skills.name: Privacy of audio and video data
skills.description: Design audio and video handling with on-device processing, visible recording indicators, minimal retention, encryption and consent for anything stored.

skills.name: Validate AI-proposed robot actions
skills.description: Check every AI-proposed action against schema, parameter limits, workspace bounds, robot state and user permissions before it reaches the controller.

skills.name: Prompt injection and untrusted inputs
skills.description: Recognize prompt injection through speech, documents or images, and keep untrusted content from changing the robot's instructions or permissions.

skills.name: Refuse unsafe or out-of-scope commands
skills.description: Detect commands that could harm people, property or the robot, refuse them politely with a reason, and offer a safe alternative when one exists.

skills.name: Confirm before consequential physical actions
skills.description: Assign actions to risk tiers and require spoken read-back and explicit confirmation before higher-risk motions, handing objects or touching people.

skills.name: Spoken stop and human override
skills.description: Provide a deterministic spoken stop command and physical override that halt motion without passing through the LLM, and verify their response time.

skills.name: Guardrails on AI-commanded robot actions
skills.description: Layer validation, refusal, confirmation, injection defenses and hardware stops so no single model error can cause an unsafe robot action.

skills.name: Log and audit AI decisions
skills.description: Log inputs, model versions, prompts, tool calls, guardrail outcomes and actions with timestamps, respecting privacy rules, so incidents can be reconstructed.

skills.name: Command a robot task safely by voice
skills.description: Integrate speech, dialogue, grounded planning and guardrails so a spoken request becomes a verified, confirmed and logged robot task.

skills.name: Elementary rotations about x, y and z
skills.description: Write the three elementary rotation matrices from an angle and apply them to rotate vectors, checking signs with the right-hand rule.

skills.name: Skew-symmetric matrix of a vector
skills.description: Build the skew-symmetric matrix that turns a cross product into a matrix product and use its algebraic properties in rotation derivations.

skills.name: Fixed-axis versus moving-axis rotation composition
skills.description: Decide whether successive rotations are about fixed world axes or current body axes and premultiply or postmultiply accordingly to get the correct total rotation.

skills.name: Euler and roll-pitch-yaw angle conventions
skills.description: Convert between a stated Euler convention such as ZYX roll-pitch-yaw or ZYZ and the equivalent rotation matrix without mixing intrinsic and extrinsic orders.

skills.name: Extract Euler angles and detect gimbal lock
skills.description: Recover Euler angles from a rotation matrix with atan2, choose a branch consistently and detect and handle the gimbal-lock configuration where angles become coupled.

skills.name: Axis-angle rotation and Rodrigues' formula
skills.description: Construct a rotation matrix from a unit axis and angle using Rodrigues' formula and interpret any rotation as a single turn about one axis.

skills.name: Rotation matrix logarithm
skills.description: Recover the axis and angle of a rotation matrix, handling the numerically delicate cases near zero and near half-turn rotations, and express orientation error as a rotation vector.

skills.name: Unit quaternions and conversions
skills.description: Represent rotations as unit quaternions, compose them, rotate vectors and convert to and from rotation matrices and axis-angle, handling the double-cover sign and storage-order conventions.

skills.name: Interpolate orientations with slerp
skills.description: Interpolate smoothly between two orientations using spherical linear interpolation, choosing the shorter path and comparing the result with naive matrix or Euler interpolation.

skills.name: Angular velocity and rotation rates
skills.description: Relate the time derivative of a rotation matrix to the angular velocity vector and distinguish spatial-frame from body-frame angular velocity.

skills.name: Twists as spatial velocities
skills.description: Represent rigid-body velocity as a six-component twist of angular and linear velocity and convert between body and spatial twist forms.

skills.name: Adjoint map for changing twist frames
skills.description: Build the 6x6 adjoint matrix of a homogeneous transform and use it to express a twist or screw axis in a different frame.

skills.name: Exponential coordinates of rigid motion
skills.description: Write the screw axis of a revolute or prismatic joint and compute the rigid motion along it with the SE(3) matrix exponential, recovering screw coordinates with the logarithm.

skills.name: Wrenches and their frame transformation
skills.description: Represent a force and moment pair as a wrench and transform it between frames with the transpose of the adjoint, preserving power with twists.

skills.name: Assign Denavit-Hartenberg frames
skills.description: Place link frames on a serial arm following the classic Denavit-Hartenberg rules, including parallel and intersecting joint axes, and fill in the parameter table.

skills.name: Link transform from a DH row
skills.description: Compute the homogeneous transform between consecutive links from a row of theta, d, a and alpha values and chain them in order.

skills.name: Forward kinematics of a serial arm with transforms
skills.description: Compute the full end-effector pose of a six-joint spatial arm by chaining link transforms in code and verify the result at known configurations.

skills.name: Product-of-exponentials forward kinematics
skills.description: Compute forward kinematics from screw axes and a home configuration with the space-frame and body-frame product-of-exponentials formulas and compare with the DH result.

skills.name: Verify forward kinematics against a URDF model
skills.description: Load the arm's URDF and compare hand-computed forward kinematics with tf2 or a kinematics library, resolving frame, offset and sign mismatches.

skills.name: Reachable and dexterous workspace mapping
skills.description: Map an arm's reachable and dexterous workspace by sampling forward kinematics within joint limits and judge whether target task locations are reachable with margin.

skills.name: Spherical wrist geometry and wrist center
skills.description: Identify a spherical wrist whose three axes intersect, locate the wrist center from the tool pose, and explain why it decouples position from orientation.

skills.name: Kinematic tree of a humanoid upper body
skills.description: Model a humanoid torso with two arms and a head as a branched kinematic tree and compute forward kinematics for each chain from a shared torso frame.

skills.name: Decouple position and orientation IK at the wrist
skills.description: Split inverse kinematics of a spherical-wrist arm into a wrist-center position problem and a wrist orientation problem.

skills.name: Analytic position IK for an anthropomorphic arm
skills.description: Solve the first three joint angles that place the wrist center, enumerating shoulder-left/right and elbow-up/down branches with atan2.

skills.name: Analytic wrist orientation IK
skills.description: Compute the remaining wrist rotation from the first three joints and extract the last three joint angles, including the flip solution and wrist singularity.

skills.name: Newton IK for full pose using matrix logarithm error
skills.description: Iterate Newton steps on a six-dimensional pose error from the SE(3) logarithm and the body Jacobian until position and orientation tolerances are met.

skills.name: Damped least-squares IK
skills.description: Stabilize numerical IK near singularities with damped least squares, choosing or scheduling the damping factor to trade tracking accuracy for bounded joint steps.

skills.name: Joint limits in numerical IK
skills.description: Keep numerical IK solutions inside joint position limits using clamping, limit-avoidance weighting or bounded optimization, and detect unreachable targets gracefully.

skills.name: Numerical inverse kinematics
skills.description: Build a robust numerical IK solver with seeding, multiple restarts, convergence and limit checks that returns verified joint solutions for a six- or seven-joint arm.

skills.name: Redundant-arm IK with elbow control
skills.description: Solve IK for a seven-joint arm while using the spare degree of freedom to control elbow angle or avoid limits through a null-space objective.

skills.name: Manipulator Jacobian
skills.description: Compute the geometric Jacobian of a spatial serial arm column by column from joint axes and positions and use it to map joint velocities to end-effector twist.

skills.name: Analytic versus geometric Jacobian
skills.description: Relate the analytic Jacobian of a minimal pose representation to the geometric Jacobian through the Euler-rate mapping and explain the representation singularities it introduces.

skills.name: Verify a Jacobian by finite differences
skills.description: Check an analytic Jacobian numerically with finite differences of forward kinematics, including orientation columns, and diagnose step-size and frame errors.

skills.name: Static force mapping through the Jacobian transpose
skills.description: Compute the joint torques that balance an end-effector wrench with the Jacobian transpose and use it to size or check actuator loads.

skills.name: Singularities of a spatial arm
skills.description: Locate wrist, elbow and shoulder singularities of a six-joint arm from the Jacobian determinant or singular values and describe the lost motion directions.

skills.name: Manipulability ellipsoid and conditioning
skills.description: Compute manipulability, condition number and velocity or force ellipsoids from the Jacobian SVD and use them to choose well-conditioned arm postures.

skills.name: Resolved-rate Cartesian velocity control
skills.description: Command end-effector velocities by inverting or pseudo-inverting the Jacobian each control cycle, with velocity limits and drift correction from pose error.

skills.name: Redundancy and null-space projection
skills.description: Use the null-space projector of a redundant arm's Jacobian to pursue a secondary objective without disturbing the primary end-effector task.

skills.name: Jacobian derivative and acceleration kinematics
skills.description: Compute the Jacobian time derivative and the bias acceleration term to relate joint accelerations to end-effector accelerations.

skills.name: Cubic polynomial joint trajectories
skills.description: Fit a cubic polynomial between two joint positions with specified boundary velocities and evaluate position, velocity and acceleration over time.

skills.name: Quintic polynomial trajectories
skills.description: Fit a quintic polynomial matching position, velocity and acceleration at both ends to avoid acceleration jumps at motion start and stop.

skills.name: Trapezoidal velocity profiles
skills.description: Plan a trapezoidal velocity move from distance, velocity limit and acceleration limit, including the triangular case when the cruise speed is never reached.

skills.name: Synchronize multi-joint moves
skills.description: Time-scale each joint's profile so all joints start and finish together, set by the slowest joint under its velocity and acceleration limits.

skills.name: Path and time-scaling separation
skills.description: Separate a geometric path from its time scaling s(t) and verify that the resulting joint velocities and accelerations stay within limits.

skills.name: Cubic and B-spline trajectories
skills.description: Fit natural or clamped cubic splines and B-splines through waypoints and compare their continuity, local control and overshoot.

skills.name: Generate smooth joint trajectories
skills.description: Generate limit-respecting, synchronized and smooth multi-joint trajectories from waypoints and stream them at a fixed rate to joint controllers.

skills.name: Cartesian straight-line paths
skills.description: Generate a straight-line tool path with slerped orientation, time-scale it, and convert it to joint trajectories with IK while checking for singularities.

skills.name: Execute trajectories with ros2_control
skills.description: Send joint trajectories to a ros2_control joint trajectory controller, configure tolerances and monitor execution feedback on simulated and real arms.

skills.name: Feedback block diagram algebra
skills.description: Reduce series, parallel and feedback block diagrams to a single closed-loop transfer function and identify reference, error, disturbance and noise signals.

skills.name: Differential equation model of a motor-driven joint
skills.description: Write the coupled electrical and mechanical differential equations of a geared motor driving an inertial, damped joint and state the modeling assumptions.

skills.name: Transfer functions from differential equations
skills.description: Derive transfer functions from linear differential equations with Laplace transforms and reduce a motor-joint model to voltage-to-velocity and voltage-to-position forms.

skills.name: Poles, zeros and response character
skills.description: Locate poles and zeros of a transfer function and predict decay rates, oscillation and stability of the response from their positions in the complex plane.

skills.name: Second-order response specifications
skills.description: Relate damping ratio and natural frequency to overshoot, rise time, peak time and settling time, and translate response specs into pole locations.

skills.name: Stability tests and Routh-Hurwitz
skills.description: Test closed-loop stability from the characteristic polynomial with the Routh-Hurwitz criterion and find the gain range that keeps a loop stable.

skills.name: Frequency response and Bode plots
skills.description: Evaluate a transfer function's gain and phase versus frequency and construct asymptotic Bode plots to read bandwidth, corner frequencies and resonances.

skills.name: Gain and phase margins
skills.description: Determine crossover frequencies and gain and phase margins from a loop's Bode plot and relate margins to overshoot and robustness.

skills.name: Discretize a continuous controller
skills.description: Convert a continuous controller to a difference equation using forward Euler, backward Euler, Tustin or zero-order-hold methods and compare their accuracy.

skills.name: Sample rate and delay effects
skills.description: Choose a control loop rate from closed-loop bandwidth and sensors, and predict the phase loss and instability risk caused by sampling, computation delay and jitter.

skills.name: Proportional joint position control
skills.description: Tune the proportional gain of a joint position loop and predict its stiffness, response speed and steady-state error under gravity load.

skills.name: Derivative action and damping
skills.description: Add derivative action to a joint position loop, interpret PD control as a virtual spring and damper, and tune it for a target damping ratio.

skills.name: Integral action for zero steady-state error
skills.description: Add integral action to remove steady-state error from constant loads, justify it with the final value theorem, and explain the phase lag and overshoot it introduces.

skills.name: Integrator anti-windup
skills.description: Prevent integrator windup under actuator saturation with conditional integration, clamping or back-calculation and compare responses after a saturating move.

skills.name: Derivative filtering and derivative-on-measurement
