skills.description: Low-pass filter the derivative term and differentiate the measurement instead of the error to avoid noise amplification and setpoint kick.

skills.name: Estimate joint velocity from encoder counts
skills.description: Estimate joint velocity from quantized encoder counts using differencing, period timing or filtering, and quantify the resulting noise and lag.

skills.name: Implement a discrete PID controller
skills.description: Implement a fixed-rate discrete PID with output limits, anti-windup, filtered derivative and bumpless mode transfer on a microcontroller.

skills.name: PID tuning methods
skills.description: Tune PID gains with manual heuristics, Ziegler-Nichols or relay-feedback tests and refine them against measured step and disturbance responses.

skills.name: Tune PID position control of a joint
skills.description: Tune and verify a PID joint position controller on hardware to meet overshoot, settling time and steady-state error specifications under realistic loads.

skills.name: Tune a motor current loop
skills.description: Design a PI current controller from winding resistance and inductance so the torque-producing current tracks commands with the required bandwidth.

skills.name: Cascaded position, velocity and current loops
skills.description: Structure a joint servo as nested current, velocity and position loops, tune from the inside out and keep adequate bandwidth separation between loops.

skills.name: Gravity compensation for a single joint
skills.description: Add a configuration-dependent gravity torque feedforward to a joint controller and show the reduction in integral effort and steady-state error.

skills.name: Velocity and acceleration feedforward
skills.description: Add velocity and acceleration feedforward from a planned trajectory using estimated damping and inertia so feedback only corrects residual error.

skills.name: Joint friction models
skills.description: Describe Coulomb, viscous and Stribeck friction and stiction in geared joints and choose a model suitable for compensation or simulation.

skills.name: Friction compensation
skills.description: Add model-based friction feedforward with a smoothed sign function near zero velocity and evaluate its effect on low-speed tracking and limit cycles.

skills.name: Gravity torque vector of a multi-joint arm
skills.description: Compute the gravity torque on every joint of a spatial arm from link masses and centers of mass using link Jacobian transposes.

skills.name: PD control with gravity compensation for an arm
skills.description: Control a multi-joint arm with joint PD plus full gravity compensation and explain why it converges to the setpoint regardless of posture.

skills.name: Rigid-body inertia tensor
skills.description: Compute and rotate a 3D inertia tensor, apply the parallel-axis theorem in 3D, and read principal axes and moments from CAD data.

skills.name: Newton-Euler equations of a single rigid body
skills.description: Write the translational and rotational equations of motion of one rigid body in a body frame, including the gyroscopic term from angular velocity.

skills.name: Lagrangian dynamics of a two-link arm
skills.description: Derive the equations of motion of a planar two-link arm from kinetic and potential energy with the Euler-Lagrange equations.

skills.name: Manipulator mass matrix
skills.description: Assemble the joint-space mass matrix from link Jacobians and inertias and use its symmetry and positive definiteness to check a model.

skills.name: Coriolis and centrifugal terms
skills.description: Compute Coriolis and centrifugal torques with Christoffel symbols and verify the skew-symmetry property used in robot control stability proofs.

skills.name: Rigid-body dynamics of a manipulator
skills.description: Write and interpret the manipulator equation relating joint torques to mass matrix, Coriolis, gravity and external wrench terms for a spatial arm.

skills.name: Recursive Newton-Euler inverse dynamics
skills.description: Implement the recursive Newton-Euler algorithm to compute joint torques from positions, velocities and accelerations with outward and inward passes.

skills.name: Forward dynamics simulation
skills.description: Simulate arm motion by solving the manipulator equation for joint accelerations and integrating with a suitable numerical integrator.

skills.name: Floating-base and centroidal dynamics
skills.description: Extend manipulator dynamics to an unactuated floating base and compute the humanoid's centroidal momentum and its relation to external contact forces.

skills.name: Computed-torque control
skills.description: Linearize arm dynamics by inverse-dynamics feedforward plus PD feedback on trajectory error and analyze sensitivity to model errors.

skills.name: Operational space control
skills.description: Compute task-space inertia and command end-effector accelerations through dynamically consistent torque control, with null-space posture control for redundancy.

skills.name: Use a force-torque sensor
skills.description: Read a wrist force-torque sensor, remove bias and tool gravity, and transform measured wrenches to the contact frame.

skills.name: Explicit force control
skills.description: Regulate contact force with feedback on measured force error and explain why stiff environments and sensor delay threaten stability.

skills.name: Impedance control
skills.description: Make the end effector behave like a chosen mass, spring and damper in task space using torque control with gravity compensation.

skills.name: Admittance control
skills.description: Turn measured contact forces into compliant position commands for stiff, position-controlled arms and tune virtual mass and damping for stability.

skills.name: Collision detection with a momentum observer
skills.description: Detect unexpected contacts by estimating external joint torques with a generalized momentum observer and set thresholds that avoid false alarms.

skills.name: Collision reaction strategies
skills.description: Choose and implement post-collision reactions such as stopping, retracting or switching to compliance consistent with human-contact force limits.

skills.name: Configuration space and C-obstacles
skills.description: Represent arm configurations as points in configuration space and explain how workspace obstacles map to complex C-space obstacle regions.

skills.name: Collision checking for an arm
skills.description: Check robot configurations and motion segments for self and environment collisions with geometric libraries, distance queries and edge discretization.

skills.name: Rapidly-exploring random trees
skills.description: Implement an RRT planner that samples configurations, extends toward them and returns a collision-free path between two arm configurations.

skills.name: RRT-Connect and RRT*
skills.description: Use bidirectional RRT-Connect for fast queries and RRT* for asymptotically shorter paths, and compare success rate, time and path cost.

skills.name: Probabilistic roadmaps
skills.description: Build a probabilistic roadmap for repeated planning queries in a static scene and search it with a graph algorithm.

skills.name: Collision-free arm motion planning
skills.description: Plan, shortcut, smooth, time-parameterize and validate collision-free arm motions from a start configuration to an IK-derived goal in a cluttered scene.

skills.name: Trajectory optimization for arms
skills.description: Formulate arm motion as an optimization with smoothness, collision-distance and limit terms in the style of CHOMP or TrajOpt and solve it iteratively.

skills.name: Configure and plan with MoveIt 2
skills.description: Generate a MoveIt 2 configuration from URDF and SRDF, then plan and execute motions using the planning scene, collision objects and pose constraints.

skills.name: Plan for a dual-arm humanoid upper body
skills.description: Plan coordinated or independent motions for two arms, torso and head with self-collision avoidance in a shared humanoid planning scene.

skills.name: Complementary filter design
skills.description: Fuse a gyroscope with an accelerometer tilt estimate using a complementary filter and choose its crossover frequency from sensor noise and drift.

skills.name: Linear Gaussian state-space estimation model
skills.description: Write process and measurement models with noise covariances Q and R for a robot estimation problem such as joint or base motion.

skills.name: Linear Kalman filter
skills.description: Implement the Kalman predict and update steps, interpret the gain and covariance, and apply it to fuse noisy robot measurements.

skills.name: Tune and validate a Kalman filter
skills.description: Tune Q and R from data and check filter consistency with innovation statistics such as NIS and NEES on logged runs.

skills.name: Extended Kalman filter
skills.description: Linearize nonlinear process and measurement models with Jacobians at each step to run an extended Kalman filter and recognize its divergence risks.

skills.name: Unscented Kalman filter overview
skills.description: Explain how sigma points propagate mean and covariance through nonlinear models and decide when a UKF is preferable to an EKF.

skills.name: State-space models
skills.description: Write state, input and output equations for a joint or mobile robot model and convert between state-space and transfer-function forms.

skills.name: Linearize nonlinear dynamics
skills.description: Linearize nonlinear robot dynamics such as a pendulum or cart-pole about an equilibrium and judge local stability from the eigenvalues.

skills.name: Controllability and observability
skills.description: Test controllability and observability with rank conditions and explain what an uncontrollable or unobservable mode means for a robot.

skills.name: State feedback by pole placement
skills.description: Design full-state feedback gains that place closed-loop poles at chosen locations and check the resulting actuator effort.

skills.name: Luenberger observer design
skills.description: Design a state observer whose error dynamics converge faster than the controller and apply the separation principle to combine them.

skills.name: Linear quadratic regulator
skills.description: Design continuous and discrete LQR controllers by choosing state and input weights, solving the Riccati equation numerically and adding integral action for tracking.

skills.name: Balance an inverted pendulum with LQR
skills.description: Stabilize a simulated cart-pole or inverted pendulum with LQR and measure its robustness to push disturbances and model error.

skills.name: Quadratic programs for control
skills.description: Formulate costs and linear constraints as a quadratic program and solve it with a solver such as OSQP, interpreting active constraints.

skills.name: Model predictive control
skills.description: Formulate linear MPC as a receding-horizon quadratic program with state and input constraints and implement it in a control loop.

skills.name: Nonlinear MPC with iLQR or DDP
skills.description: Optimize nonlinear robot trajectories with iterative LQR or differential dynamic programming and use them inside a receding-horizon controller.

skills.name: Task definitions and task Jacobians
skills.description: Define end-effector, gaze, posture and center-of-mass tasks for a humanoid with task errors and Jacobians over all joints.

skills.name: Strict task priority via null-space projection
skills.description: Execute a primary task exactly and lower-priority tasks only within its null space using recursive projection, handling algorithmic singularities.

skills.name: QP-based differential inverse kinematics
skills.description: Solve weighted multi-task differential IK as a QP with joint position, velocity and collision-distance inequality constraints each control cycle.

skills.name: Center-of-mass control on a wheeled humanoid
skills.description: Keep a wheeled humanoid's center of mass projection inside its support polygon while reaching, using a CoM Jacobian task.

skills.name: Whole-body control with task priorities
skills.description: Coordinate base, torso, both arms and head of a wheeled humanoid through a prioritized whole-body controller with safety constraints on hardware or simulation.

skills.name: Torque-level whole-body QP control
skills.description: Compute joint torques and contact forces in one QP that respects dynamics, torque limits and friction cones while tracking prioritized tasks.

skills.name: Identify a plant model from step data
skills.description: Fit first- and second-order plant parameters such as gain, time constant and damping to logged step responses of a joint.

skills.name: Measure frequency response with sweeps
skills.description: Measure a joint's frequency response with chirp or stepped-sine excitation and fit a transfer function to the measured Bode data.

skills.name: Identify joint friction parameters
skills.description: Identify Coulomb and viscous friction parameters from constant-velocity torque or current measurements using least-squares fitting.

skills.name: Linear-in-parameters dynamics regressor
skills.description: Rewrite manipulator dynamics as a regressor matrix times inertial parameters and identify base parameters with least squares.

skills.name: Calibrate joint zero offsets
skills.description: Calibrate joint zero positions with fixtures, reference poses or absolute encoders and record offsets reproducibly in configuration.

skills.name: Kinematic calibration of arm geometry
skills.description: Identify link-length, offset and joint-zero errors from externally measured end-effector poses with nonlinear least squares and validate on held-out poses.

skills.name: Use a current-limited bench power supply
skills.description: Set voltage and current limits on a bench supply, read constant-current mode, and use it to power an untested circuit without damaging it.

skills.name: Solder through-hole components
skills.description: Tin the iron, heat pad and lead together, form a concave fillet, and inspect through-hole joints for cold, dry or bridged solder.

skills.name: ESD handling and on-board ESD protection
skills.description: Handle sensitive parts with grounded straps and mats, and add TVS diodes and series resistors to protect exposed connector and MCU pins from discharge.

skills.name: Hand-solder surface-mount parts
skills.description: Hand-solder 0805 passives, SOIC and fine-pitch ICs with flux, tack-and-drag technique and hot air, then inspect for bridges, tombstones and insufficient fillets.

skills.name: Rework and repair a circuit board
skills.description: Remove and replace components using wick, desoldering pump and hot air, and repair lifted pads or cut traces with jumper wire without damaging neighbors.

skills.name: Trigger and capture events on an oscilloscope
skills.description: Configure edge, pulse-width and single-shot triggers, set timebase and vertical scale, and capture an intermittent glitch or a PWM edge for measurement.

skills.name: Probe switching circuits safely and accurately
skills.description: Compensate probes, use short ground springs, avoid shorting through the scope's earth ground, and measure floating switch nodes with differential or isolated probes.

skills.name: Capture and decode buses with a logic analyzer
skills.description: Connect a logic analyzer to UART, SPI and I2C lines, choose sample rate and thresholds, and use protocol decoders to verify bytes and timing.

skills.name: Bring up a new circuit board safely
skills.description: Inspect a fresh board, check rails for shorts with a meter, power it current-limited, verify each rail and clock, and log findings before loading firmware.

skills.name: Read a power MOSFET datasheet
skills.description: Extract drain-source rating, on-resistance versus gate voltage and temperature, gate charge, body diode and safe operating area from a MOSFET datasheet.

skills.name: MOSFET conduction loss at temperature
skills.description: Calculate RMS-current conduction loss in a MOSFET using on-resistance corrected for junction temperature and PWM duty cycle.

skills.name: Gate charge and gate-drive current
skills.description: Use total gate charge and Miller plateau charge to compute switching time from driver current and choose a gate resistor value.

skills.name: Estimate MOSFET switching loss
skills.description: Estimate turn-on and turn-off energy from bus voltage, current and transition time, and scale it by PWM frequency to get switching power.

skills.name: Drive a low-side MOSFET from a microcontroller
skills.description: Switch a solenoid, LED strip or fan with a logic-level N-MOSFET using a gate resistor, gate pulldown and flyback diode driven from a GPIO pin.

skills.name: High-side drive and bootstrap supply
skills.description: Explain why high-side N-MOSFETs need a gate voltage above the bus, and size a bootstrap capacitor and diode for a given gate charge and duty limit.

skills.name: Choose dead time to prevent shoot-through
skills.description: Pick a half-bridge dead time from driver delays and switching times, and predict the body-diode conduction and voltage error it introduces.

skills.name: H-bridge drive and decay modes
skills.description: Compare sign-magnitude and locked-antiphase PWM, and fast versus slow decay, in terms of current path, braking behavior and low-speed control.

skills.name: Motor current ripple from PWM
skills.description: Calculate peak-to-peak armature current ripple from bus voltage, duty cycle, PWM frequency and winding inductance, and its effect on RMS heating.

skills.name: Choose a motor PWM frequency
skills.description: Select a PWM frequency that balances current ripple, switching loss, audible whine and controller timing for a given motor and driver.

skills.name: Drive a brushed motor with an H-bridge and PWM
skills.description: Wire an H-bridge between supply, motor and microcontroller, generate direction and PWM signals, and verify speed control and braking on the bench.

skills.name: Select and use an integrated motor driver IC
skills.description: Choose a motor driver IC by voltage, continuous and peak current, and package, then configure its current limit, sleep, and fault pins.

skills.name: Handle motor driver fault signals
skills.description: Interpret overcurrent, thermal shutdown and undervoltage lockout flags from a motor driver and implement a safe latch, report and recovery sequence.

skills.name: Junction temperature of a power stage
skills.description: Sum conduction and switching losses and use junction-to-ambient thermal resistance to predict MOSFET or driver temperature and decide on heatsinking.

skills.name: Three-phase inverter bridge
skills.description: Describe the six-switch three-phase bridge, its eight switching states, and how phase voltages are applied to a brushless motor's windings.

skills.name: Six-step commutation with Hall sensors
skills.description: Map Hall sensor states to the correct bridge switching pattern for trapezoidal commutation and predict torque ripple and direction reversal.

skills.name: Sinusoidal and space-vector PWM
skills.description: Compute three-phase duty cycles for sinusoidal and space-vector PWM from a desired voltage vector and compare their bus-voltage utilization.

skills.name: Size a current-sense shunt resistor
skills.description: Choose a shunt value that gives adequate signal at full-scale current while keeping dissipation, voltage drop and power rating within limits.

skills.name: Current-sense amplifiers and Kelvin connections
skills.description: Compare low-side and high-side sensing, set amplifier gain and common-mode range, and route Kelvin sense traces so lead resistance does not corrupt readings.

skills.name: Hall-effect current sensors
skills.description: Choose an isolated Hall-effect current sensor and account for its sensitivity, offset drift, bandwidth and stray-field susceptibility.

skills.name: Calibrate a current-sense channel
skills.description: Measure zero offset and gain against a reference meter, convert ADC codes to amperes, and filter the reading to match the control bandwidth.

skills.name: Sense a battery or bus voltage with an ADC
skills.description: Design a divider, filter capacitor and clamp so an ADC can read a high bus voltage accurately and survive overvoltage and reverse connection.

skills.name: Three-phase current sensing for motor control
skills.description: Place shunts or Hall sensors in a three-phase inverter and synchronize ADC sampling to the PWM center to obtain clean phase currents.

skills.name: Bring up a commercial BLDC/FOC driver
skills.description: Wire a brushless motor, encoder and supply to an FOC driver board, run motor calibration, tune current limits and confirm fault responses.

skills.name: UART electrical levels and framing
skills.description: Distinguish TTL, CMOS and RS-232 UART levels, identify idle and start states on a trace, and check baud-rate mismatch tolerance.

skills.name: Level-shift between logic families
skills.description: Connect 3.3 V and 5 V devices using dividers, MOSFET bidirectional shifters or buffer ICs, choosing by direction, speed and open-drain requirements.

skills.name: Size I2C pull-ups from bus capacitance
skills.description: Calculate minimum and maximum I2C pull-up resistance from sink current, bus capacitance and rise-time limits for a chosen bus speed.

skills.name: Diagnose I2C bus problems
skills.description: Find address conflicts, missing pull-ups, slow edges and a stuck SDA line using a scope and logic analyzer, and recover the bus.

skills.name: Wire SPI for reliable high-speed transfer
skills.description: Choose SPI mode, chip-select scheme and clock rate, and judge how trace length, ringing and series termination limit reliable speed.

skills.name: Differential signaling and common-mode rejection
skills.description: Explain how differential pairs reject common-mode noise and ground offsets, and why twisted pairs suit long robot cable runs.

skills.name: Transmission lines and termination
skills.description: Decide when a cable acts as a transmission line from edge rate and length, and calculate reflections for matched and mismatched terminations.

skills.name: Wire an RS-485 multidrop bus
skills.description: Build a half-duplex RS-485 bus with transceivers, termination, fail-safe biasing and driver-enable timing, and verify it with a scope.

skills.name: Wire a daisy-chained smart-servo bus
skills.description: Wire half-duplex TTL or RS-485 smart servos in a chain with power injection, ID planning and cable lengths that keep voltage drop and noise acceptable.

skills.name: CAN physical layer and termination
skills.description: Explain dominant and recessive states, CAN transceivers, 120-ohm end termination and stub limits, and verify termination by measuring 60 ohms.

skills.name: CAN frames, arbitration and bit timing
skills.description: Read CAN frame fields, predict which identifier wins arbitration, and set bit timing segments and sample point for a given bit rate.

skills.name: Wire and use a CAN bus network
skills.description: Build a terminated CAN network of several nodes, bring it up on a microcontroller or Linux SocketCAN, and send and receive frames reliably.

skills.name: Diagnose CAN bus faults
skills.description: Locate wrong termination, swapped lines, bit-rate mismatch and bus-off nodes using resistance checks, scope captures and error counters.

skills.name: CAN FD and bus-load budgeting
skills.description: Estimate CAN bus load and worst-case latency from message rates and frame sizes, and decide when CAN FD or a second bus is needed.

skills.name: USB devices in robots
skills.description: Manage USB power limits, cable length, hubs, persistent device naming and noise-induced disconnects for cameras and serial adapters on a robot computer.

skills.name: EtherCAT for multi-axis robots
skills.description: Explain EtherCAT processing on the fly, daisy-chain topology and distributed clocks, and why humanoids use it for synchronized joint control.

skills.name: Choose a bus for a robot subsystem
skills.description: Select I2C, SPI, UART, RS-485, CAN, USB or Ethernet for a subsystem by bandwidth, determinism, distance, node count and noise environment.

skills.name: Wire gauge, ampacity and voltage drop
skills.description: Choose wire gauge from continuous current, bundling and temperature limits, and calculate round-trip voltage drop and loss for a given run length.

skills.name: Choose wire stranding and insulation
skills.description: Select stranded, high-flex or silicone and PTFE insulated wire according to flexing, temperature, abrasion and voltage requirements.

skills.name: Select connectors for robot wiring
skills.description: Choose signal and power connectors by current rating, mating cycles, retention, polarization and vibration resistance, from JST and Molex to XT and M12.

skills.name: Crimp and pin a connector terminal
skills.description: Strip to length, crimp conductor and insulation wings with the correct die, insert into the housing, and pull-test and inspect the crimp.

skills.name: Build a wiring harness with crimped connectors
skills.description: Draw a pinout and wiring diagram, cut and label wires, crimp and populate connectors, sleeve and tie the bundle, and continuity-test the finished harness.

skills.name: Route cables through moving joints
skills.description: Plan service loops, bend radius, clamping and hollow-shaft paths so cables crossing a joint survive its full range of motion without pinching.

skills.name: Select a slip ring for continuous rotation
skills.description: Specify a slip ring by circuit count, current, voltage, rotational speed and signal noise when a joint must rotate beyond a cable's limit.

skills.name: Cable flex and torsion life
skills.description: Estimate and test cable life under repeated bending and torsion at a joint, and choose cable construction and routing to meet a cycle target.

skills.name: Plan a humanoid wiring architecture
skills.description: Partition a humanoid's power and data wiring into serviceable segments with joint crossings, connector breaks and bus topology across torso, arms and head.

skills.name: Star grounding and separated returns
skills.description: Arrange power and signal returns so high motor currents do not flow through sensor or logic ground paths, using star points and separate return wires.

skills.name: Identify and break ground loops
skills.description: Recognize ground loops formed by multiple return paths, predict the induced noise, and break them with single-point grounding or isolation.

skills.name: Suppress EMI from motors and switchers
skills.description: Identify noisy edges from PWM, brushes and regulators and apply motor-terminal capacitors, RC snubbers, ferrites and common-mode chokes to tame them.

skills.name: Terminate cable shields correctly
skills.description: Choose shielded or twisted-pair cable and terminate shields at one or both ends with 360-degree clamps according to frequency and ground scheme.

skills.name: Choose decoupling and bulk capacitance
skills.description: Select local decoupling values and placement and size bulk capacitance to hold a rail within tolerance during a specified load step.

skills.name: Capture a schematic in KiCad
skills.description: Draw a schematic in KiCad with symbols, net labels, power flags and hierarchical sheets, and clear all electrical rules check errors.

skills.name: Assign and verify footprints
skills.description: Assign footprints to every symbol, create a missing footprint from a datasheet land pattern, and check pin mapping and pad sizes.

skills.name: Place components on a PCB
skills.description: Place connectors, power stages, decoupling capacitors and sensitive analog parts to shorten critical loops and fit mechanical constraints.

skills.name: Size PCB traces for current
skills.description: Calculate trace width and copper weight for a current and temperature rise with IPC-2152 charts, and size vias for high-current paths.

skills.name: Ground planes and return paths on a PCB
skills.description: Use solid ground planes, avoid routing signals across plane splits, and keep high-current returns away from sensitive analog references.

skills.name: Route a two-layer PCB
skills.description: Route a two-layer board with appropriate trace widths, clearances, vias and short differential pairs while keeping return paths continuous.

skills.name: Run DRC against fab design rules
skills.description: Load a fabricator's minimum trace, space, drill and annular-ring rules into KiCad and resolve every design rule check violation.

skills.name: Generate fab files and order a PCB
skills.description: Export Gerbers, drill files, BOM and pick-and-place files, preview them in a Gerber viewer, and place a fabrication and assembly order.

skills.name: Design a simple PCB from schematic to order
skills.description: Take a small robot interface board from schematic through layout, DRC and fab outputs to an ordered, assembled and tested board.

skills.name: Lay out a motor-driver power stage
skills.description: Minimize the hot loop, route Kelvin gate and sense returns, add copper pours and thermal vias, and separate power and logic grounds on a driver board.

skills.name: Four-layer stackups and controlled impedance
skills.description: Choose a four-layer stackup and route controlled-impedance pairs for CAN, USB or Ethernet with continuous reference planes.

skills.name: Compare lithium cell chemistries
skills.description: Compare Li-ion NMC, LiPo, LiFePO4 and NiMH cells on nominal voltage, energy density, power capability, cycle life and abuse tolerance for robots.

skills.name: Cell voltage versus state of charge
skills.description: Read discharge curves to find a cell's maximum, nominal and cutoff voltages and explain why flat LiFePO4 curves make voltage a poor charge gauge.

skills.name: Read a battery cell datasheet
skills.description: Extract rated capacity, continuous and pulse discharge current, charge limits, temperature windows and cycle life conditions from a cell datasheet.

skills.name: C-rate and discharge current limits
skills.description: Convert C-rates to amperes for a given capacity and check continuous and burst discharge currents against cell and pack limits.

skills.name: Usable battery energy
skills.description: Calculate usable watt-hours from nominal capacity after depth-of-discharge limits, high-rate capacity loss, temperature derating and end-of-life fade.

skills.name: Internal resistance and voltage sag
skills.description: Predict terminal voltage and heat under load from cell internal resistance, and check that sag does not trip regulators or undervoltage cutoffs.

skills.name: Measure cell internal resistance
skills.description: Measure DC internal resistance with a pulse-load step and compare it with AC impedance meter readings to grade cells.

skills.name: Series and parallel cell configurations
skills.description: Compute pack voltage, capacity, energy and current capability for an xSyP arrangement and choose cell counts to hit a target bus voltage.

skills.name: Design a lithium battery pack
skills.description: Choose chemistry, cell, series-parallel layout and capacity to meet voltage, energy, peak current and mass targets for a robot.

skills.name: Build a battery pack
skills.description: Spot-weld nickel interconnects, add cell holders, insulation, sense leads and fusing, and assemble a pack with proper strain relief and compression.

skills.name: Design a battery enclosure and mount
skills.description: Design a pack enclosure with crush protection, venting path, thermal path and quick-release mounting inside a robot base or torso.

skills.name: Battery management system functions
skills.description: Explain how a BMS monitors cell voltages, current and temperatures and opens protection FETs on overvoltage, undervoltage, overcurrent, short or overtemperature.

skills.name: Cell imbalance and balancing
skills.description: Explain how mismatched cells drift apart, compare passive and active balancing, and compute the time to correct an imbalance at a given balance current.

skills.name: Set BMS protection thresholds
skills.description: Choose overvoltage, undervoltage, overcurrent and temperature thresholds and delays from cell limits and robot peak loads without nuisance trips.

skills.name: Estimate state of charge
skills.description: Implement coulomb counting with voltage-based rest correction to estimate state of charge and bound its drift.

skills.name: Model-based state-of-charge estimation
skills.description: Fit an equivalent-circuit battery model from pulse tests and fuse current and voltage in a Kalman filter to estimate state of charge.

skills.name: Read smart-battery telemetry
skills.description: Read cell voltages, current, temperature, state of charge and fault flags from a smart BMS over SMBus, UART or CAN.

skills.name: Constant-current constant-voltage charging
skills.description: Describe CC/CV charging, compute charge time from capacity and current, and choose termination current and chemistry-specific voltage setpoints.

skills.name: Select and configure a battery charger
skills.description: Match a charger to a pack's chemistry, series count, charge current, balancing needs and cold-temperature charge prohibition.

skills.name: Reverse-polarity protection
skills.description: Protect a robot input from reversed battery connection using a series diode or P-MOSFET and compare their voltage drop and dissipation.

skills.name: Ideal-diode ORing of power sources
skills.description: Combine battery, charger and external supply inputs with ideal-diode controllers so the robot switches source without back-feeding or brownout.

skills.name: Charge while operating
skills.description: Design the power path that lets a robot charge its pack while running, sharing charger current between load and battery safely.

skills.name: Design docking charge contacts
skills.description: Design dock contacts for current rating, alignment tolerance, wear, corrosion and arc avoidance, and keep exposed contacts dead until docking is confirmed.

skills.name: Choose linear or switching regulation
skills.description: Pick an LDO or switching converter from dropout, dissipated heat, noise and efficiency, and check LDO junction temperature for the load.

skills.name: Converter efficiency and input current
skills.description: Use efficiency curves to compute converter input current, battery-side power and heat, including light-load efficiency penalties.

skills.name: Select DC-DC modules for robot rails
skills.description: Choose buck, boost or buck-boost modules for logic, servo and compute rails by voltage range, current headroom, transient response and EMI.

skills.name: Load transients and brownouts
skills.description: Predict rail droop when actuators draw step loads and size bulk capacitance or separate rails so logic and computers do not brown out.

skills.name: Isolated DC-DC supplies
skills.description: Explain transformer-based isolated converters and decide when isolation is needed for safety, noise or ground-loop breaking in a robot.

skills.name: Power an onboard computer robustly
skills.description: Supply a single-board computer or GPU module with adequate headroom, sequencing and power-good, and add hold-up so it can shut down cleanly.

skills.name: Select a fuse
skills.description: Choose fuse current rating, time-current curve, I-squared-t, DC voltage rating and breaking capacity so the wire is protected but normal surges pass.

skills.name: Breakers, PTCs and electronic fuses
skills.description: Compare DC circuit breakers, resettable PTC fuses and eFuse or hot-swap controllers by trip speed, reset behavior and fault reporting.

skills.name: Coordinate branch and main fuses
skills.description: Select branch and main protection so a fault in one actuator branch clears locally before the main fuse or BMS disconnects the robot.

skills.name: Busbars and bolted power connections
skills.description: Size copper busbars for current and temperature rise, and make bolted electrical joints with correct plating, washers and torque.

skills.name: Pre-charge capacitive loads
skills.description: Size a pre-charge resistor and time to limit inrush into motor-driver bus capacitance, and check resistor pulse energy rating.

skills.name: DC contactors and relays
skills.description: Select DC contactors and relays by voltage, current and arc-breaking capability, add coil suppression, and detect welded contacts.

skills.name: Design fused power distribution for many actuators
skills.description: Lay out a power tree from battery through main disconnect, pre-charge, busbars and fused branches to many actuators with voltage drop checked.

skills.name: Stop categories and e-stop requirements
skills.description: Explain stop categories 0, 1 and 2 and what an emergency stop must guarantee about energy removal, latching and manual reset.

skills.name: Safety relays and dual-channel circuits
skills.description: Wire a dual-channel e-stop to a safety relay with forced-guided contacts, cross-monitoring and monitored reset, and explain each failure it detects.

skills.name: Design an emergency stop and safe power-off circuit
skills.description: Design an e-stop chain that removes actuator power independently of software, latches until reset and leaves logic powered for diagnosis.

skills.name: Verify e-stop response by test
skills.description: Measure e-stop response and stopping time with a scope, inject single faults, and record results against the stop requirement.

skills.name: Wireless and heartbeat-based stops
skills.description: Add a wireless or remote stop that halts the robot on button press or lost heartbeat, and explain its limits versus a hardwired e-stop.

skills.name: Safe torque off at motor drives
skills.description: Compare safe torque off inside a drive with cutting bus power, including restart time, gravity loads and what the safety function guarantees.

skills.name: Regenerative energy and bus voltage rise
skills.description: Calculate energy returned by a decelerating joint or wheel and the resulting DC bus voltage rise on a given bus capacitance.

skills.name: Size a braking resistor and chopper
skills.description: Set a brake-chopper threshold and size a braking resistor's resistance, peak power and average power for a regeneration profile.

skills.name: Size DC bus capacitance
skills.description: Size motor-drive bus capacitors for ripple current, voltage hold-up and regenerative energy absorption, including ripple-current rating and lifetime.

skills.name: Regenerating into a battery safely
skills.description: Decide when regenerative current can be absorbed by the pack, and handle a full battery or open BMS with a shunt clamp or braking resistor.

skills.name: Battery pack heat generation
skills.description: Estimate pack heat from I-squared-R losses over a duty cycle and predict temperature rise with a lumped thermal model.

skills.name: Thermal design of packs and drivers
skills.description: Design conduction paths, spacing, airflow and sensor placement to keep cells and motor drivers within temperature limits inside an enclosed robot.

skills.name: Derate current from measured temperature
skills.description: Implement firmware that reads pack and driver temperatures and reduces current limits smoothly before hardware thermal protection trips.

skills.name: Lithium battery failure and thermal runaway
skills.description: Explain how overcharge, overdischarge, shorts, puncture and heat trigger thermal runaway, and how cell chemistry changes the severity.

skills.name: Safe charging, storage and handling
skills.description: Charge supervised in fire-resistant containment, store at storage voltage, work on live packs with insulated tools, and dispose of damaged cells safely.

skills.name: Ship and transport lithium batteries
skills.description: Apply watt-hour limits, state-of-charge rules, UN38.3 test certification and packaging requirements when shipping or flying with robot batteries.

skills.name: Build an actuator load profile
skills.description: Turn a task timeline into per-actuator current and power profiles with idle, holding, moving and peak phases.

skills.name: Build a robot power budget and runtime estimate
skills.description: Sum average and peak loads through converter efficiencies to battery power, and estimate runtime from usable energy with margin.

skills.name: Check simultaneous peak loads
skills.description: Check worst-case simultaneous actuator peaks against pack current, BMS overcurrent, fuse curves and wiring so the robot never trips during motion.

skills.name: Choose a robot bus voltage
skills.description: Compare 12, 24 and 48 volt buses on current, wire mass, voltage drop, actuator availability and electrical safety for a humanoid.

skills.name: Monitor power with telemetry
skills.description: Read per-rail voltage, current and energy from monitor ICs, publish them as robot telemetry, and log them for analysis.

skills.name: Validate runtime against measurement
skills.description: Run a measured discharge during a representative task, compare it with the predicted runtime, and correct the power budget.

skills.name: Low-battery behavior policy
skills.description: Define state-of-charge thresholds for warning, return to dock and graceful shutdown that account for estimation error and the energy needed to get home.

skills.name: Power architecture of a wheeled humanoid
skills.description: Design the full power architecture of a wheeled humanoid: pack, bus voltages, distribution zones, e-stop domains, compute supply and charging.

skills.name: Conductors, insulators and free charge carriers
skills.description: Explain how mobile electrons in metals and bound electrons in insulators determine whether charge spreads through a material or stays where it was placed.

skills.name: Charging by friction, contact and induction
skills.description: Predict the sign and distribution of charge produced by triboelectric rubbing, conduction contact, and induction with grounding, including why ungrounded handling builds static charge.

skills.name: Electric field line diagrams
skills.description: Sketch and read electric field line diagrams for point charges, dipoles and plates, using line density for strength and never letting lines cross.

skills.name: Linear, surface and volume charge density
skills.description: Describe continuous charge with line, surface and volume densities and write the charge element dq for a rod, ring, disk or solid region.

skills.name: Electric field of a finite line charge
skills.description: Integrate Coulomb contributions along a uniformly charged rod to find the field at a point on its perpendicular bisector, using symmetry to cancel components.

skills.name: Electric field on the axis of a charged ring
skills.description: Derive the axial electric field of a uniformly charged ring by integration and locate where along the axis the field is strongest.

skills.name: Electric field on the axis of a charged disk
skills.description: Build a charged disk from concentric rings, integrate to find its axial field, and show the result approaches the infinite-sheet value close to the surface.

skills.name: Gauss's law with cylindrical symmetry
skills.description: Apply Gauss's law with a coaxial cylindrical surface to find the field of an infinite line charge or charged cylinder inside and outside.

skills.name: Gauss's law with planar symmetry
skills.description: Use a pillbox Gaussian surface to find the field of an infinite charged sheet and of two oppositely charged parallel sheets.

skills.name: Conductors in electrostatic equilibrium
skills.description: Show with Gauss's law that a conductor in equilibrium has zero interior field, excess charge only on its surface, and a field normal to that surface.

skills.name: Field at a conductor surface and sharp points
skills.description: Calculate the field just outside a charged conductor from its surface charge density and explain why charge and field concentrate at sharp edges and points.

skills.name: Electrostatic shielding by a closed conductor
skills.description: Explain why a field-free cavity inside a closed conductor shields its contents from external static fields, and what happens when charge is placed inside the cavity.

skills.name: Potential of point charges by superposition
skills.description: Calculate the electric potential at a point from several point charges as a scalar sum, and compare its sign and falloff with the field.

skills.name: Potential energy of a system of charges
skills.description: Compute the total electrostatic potential energy of an assembly of point charges by summing pair energies, and relate it to the work needed to assemble them.

skills.name: Electric field from the potential gradient
skills.description: Obtain the electric field as the negative gradient of a given potential function and interpret field direction as steepest potential decrease.

skills.name: Potential difference from a line integral of the field
skills.description: Integrate the electric field along a path to find potential differences for spheres, line charges and uniform fields, including the logarithmic potential of a line charge.

skills.name: Equipotential surfaces
skills.description: Sketch equipotential surfaces perpendicular to field lines, explain why a conductor is an equipotential, and why no work is done moving charge along one.

skills.name: Capacitance of coaxial cylinders
skills.description: Derive the capacitance per unit length of a coaxial cable from the field between cylinders, and estimate the capacitance of a real cable run.

skills.name: Series and parallel capacitor combinations
skills.description: Calculate equivalent capacitance, charge and voltage sharing for capacitors in series, parallel and simple mixed networks.

skills.name: Energy density of the electric field
skills.description: Show that a parallel-plate capacitor's stored energy equals one half epsilon zero E squared times its volume, and use field energy density in estimates.

skills.name: Dielectric constant and capacitance
skills.description: Calculate how inserting a dielectric of relative permittivity changes capacitance, stored charge, field and energy at fixed voltage and at fixed charge.

skills.name: Dielectric polarization and bound charge
skills.description: Explain how induced and permanent molecular dipoles polarize a dielectric, creating bound surface charge that reduces the internal field and attracts neutral objects.

skills.name: Dielectric strength, breakdown, clearance and creepage
skills.description: Use dielectric strength to find the maximum voltage across a gap or insulator, and explain how air breakdown sets PCB clearance and surface contamination sets creepage.

skills.name: Drift velocity of charge carriers
skills.description: Relate current to carrier density, charge and drift velocity, and calculate the surprisingly slow drift speed of electrons in a copper wire.

skills.name: Current density
skills.description: Calculate current density as current per cross-sectional area and as carrier density times charge times drift velocity, and compare densities in wires and traces.

skills.name: Resistivity, conductivity and microscopic Ohm's law
skills.description: State the microscopic Ohm's law J equals sigma E, convert between resistivity and conductivity, and compare copper, aluminium, steel and carbon values.

skills.name: Wire resistance from geometry
skills.description: Calculate a conductor's resistance from resistivity, length and cross-sectional area, and predict how resistance scales when wire gauge or length changes.

skills.name: Temperature dependence of resistance
skills.description: Apply the linear temperature coefficient of resistivity to predict how much a copper winding's resistance rises when it heats from room temperature to operating temperature.

skills.name: Joule heating as microscopic power density
skills.description: Express resistive heating as power per volume J dot E, integrate it over a conductor, and locate hot spots where current crowds into narrow sections.

skills.name: Biot-Savart law
skills.description: Write the magnetic field contribution of a current element using the Biot-Savart law and determine its direction with the cross product and right-hand rule.

skills.name: Magnetic field of a long straight wire
skills.description: Derive and apply B equals mu zero I over two pi r for a long straight wire, including the circular field direction from the right-hand grip rule.

skills.name: Magnetic field on the axis of a circular loop
skills.description: Integrate the Biot-Savart law around a circular current loop to find the axial field, and evaluate it at the centre and far along the axis.

skills.name: Superposing fields of several currents
skills.description: Add the vector fields of multiple parallel wires to find net fields, and show why closely spaced go and return conductors largely cancel at a distance.

skills.name: Ampere's law with symmetric currents
skills.description: Apply Ampere's circuital law with an Amperian loop to find the field inside and outside a thick wire and recognise when symmetry makes it usable.

skills.name: Magnetic field inside a solenoid
skills.description: Use Ampere's law to show a long solenoid has a nearly uniform interior field of mu zero n I, and estimate field strength for a practical coil.

skills.name: Magnetic field inside a toroid
skills.description: Use Ampere's law to find the field inside a toroidal coil, show it varies with radius and vanishes outside, and explain why toroids leak little flux.

skills.name: Force between parallel currents
skills.description: Calculate the force per unit length between two parallel current-carrying conductors and determine whether they attract or repel from current directions.

skills.name: Magnetic dipole moment of a current loop
skills.description: Calculate the magnetic moment N I A of a coil, assign its direction with the right-hand rule, and relate it to the far field of the loop.

skills.name: Torque and energy of a magnetic dipole
skills.description: Calculate the torque m cross B and potential energy minus m dot B of a magnetic dipole, and predict stable and unstable alignment like a compass needle.

skills.name: Hall effect physics
skills.description: Derive the Hall voltage from the balance of magnetic and electric forces on drifting carriers, and use its sign and size to infer carrier type and density.

skills.name: Earth's magnetic field
skills.description: Describe Earth's field magnitude, declination and inclination, and resolve it into horizontal and vertical components at a given location for heading calculations.

skills.name: Stray fields from robot wiring near a magnetometer
skills.description: Estimate the magnetic field a motor or battery cable produces at a magnetometer and compare it with Earth's field to set safe sensor placement distances.

skills.name: Faraday's law calculations
skills.description: Calculate induced emf from the rate of change of magnetic flux through an N-turn coil for changing field, area or orientation, with Lenz's law for sign.

skills.name: Flux linkage
skills.description: Define flux linkage as turns times flux, distinguish it from flux through one turn, and write induced voltage as its time derivative.

skills.name: Emf of a coil rotating in a uniform field
skills.description: Derive the sinusoidal emf N B A omega sin omega t of a coil spinning in a uniform field and identify where in the rotation it peaks.

skills.name: AC generator output
skills.description: Calculate peak and RMS emf, frequency and delivered power for a simple AC generator driving a resistive load, and relate shaft torque to electrical load.

skills.name: Induced electric fields
skills.description: Explain that a changing magnetic flux produces a circulating, non-conservative electric field, and calculate its magnitude around a symmetric changing flux region.

skills.name: Sliding rod on rails: induced current and drag
skills.description: Solve a conducting rod on rails in a magnetic field for induced current, retarding force, dissipated power and terminal speed under a constant applied force.

skills.name: Eddy currents
skills.description: Explain how changing flux drives circulating eddy currents in bulk conductors and how their loss scales with conductivity, frequency, field and conductor thickness.

skills.name: Eddy-current braking and damping
skills.description: Show that eddy-current braking force is proportional to speed, model it as viscous damping, and predict the terminal speed of a magnet falling through a copper tube.

skills.name: Self-inductance of a solenoid
skills.description: Derive L equals mu zero N squared A over length from flux linkage, and predict how turns, area and length change a coil's inductance.

skills.name: Mutual inductance and coupling coefficient
skills.description: Calculate mutual inductance between coaxial coils, use reciprocity, and relate the coupling coefficient to how much flux the two windings share.

skills.name: Inductive noise pickup and loop area
skills.description: Estimate the voltage induced in a signal loop by a nearby switching current and show why reducing loop area and distance cuts magnetic coupling.

skills.name: Energy stored in a magnetic field
skills.description: Show that an inductor's energy equals B squared over two mu zero times its field volume, and use magnetic energy density to compare stored energies.

skills.name: RL time constant from coil physics
skills.description: Derive an RL current rise from Faraday's law as a first-order differential equation and compute L over R for a coil from its geometry and wire resistance.

skills.name: Magnetization of matter
skills.description: Define magnetization as magnetic dipole moment per unit volume and explain how aligned atomic dipoles act like surface currents that add to an applied field.

skills.name: B, H and permeability
skills.description: Relate B, H and magnetization through B equals mu zero times H plus M, and use relative permeability and susceptibility for linear materials.

skills.name: Diamagnetism and paramagnetism
skills.description: Distinguish diamagnetic and paramagnetic materials by the sign and tiny size of their susceptibility, and explain why neither matters for motor design.

skills.name: Ferromagnetism, domains and the Curie temperature
skills.description: Explain how exchange coupling aligns spins into domains, how domain walls move under applied field, and why ferromagnetism vanishes above the Curie temperature.

skills.name: Magnetization curves and saturation
skills.description: Read a B-H magnetization curve to extract initial permeability and saturation flux density, and explain why permeability falls as the core approaches saturation.

skills.name: Hysteresis loops, remanence and coercivity
skills.description: Trace a hysteresis loop through a magnetizing cycle and read remanent flux density and coercive field strength from it.

skills.name: Soft versus hard magnetic materials
skills.description: Classify silicon steel, ferrite, powdered iron, NdFeB, SmCo and AlNiCo as soft or hard from loop shape, and match each to cores or permanent magnets.

skills.name: Permanent magnet demagnetization curve and grades
skills.description: Read the second-quadrant demagnetization curve, maximum energy product and N-grade ratings of permanent magnets to compare remanence and coercivity across grades.

skills.name: Magnet temperature effects and irreversible demagnetization
skills.description: Use temperature coefficients and temperature-grade suffixes to predict remanence loss with heat and identify the operating point where irreversible demagnetization begins.

skills.name: Hard-iron and soft-iron distortion physics
skills.description: Explain how nearby magnets add a constant offset field and nearby steel bends the local field, producing the hard-iron and soft-iron distortions seen by magnetometers.

skills.name: Hysteresis core loss
skills.description: Calculate hysteresis energy loss per cycle from loop area and core volume, and scale it to power loss with frequency using a Steinmetz-type relation.

skills.name: Eddy-current core loss and laminations
skills.description: Estimate eddy-current loss in a magnetic core as proportional to sheet thickness squared and frequency squared, and justify laminations, ferrites and powdered cores.

skills.name: Magnetic circuits and reluctance
skills.description: Model a magnetic core as a circuit with magnetomotive force N I, reluctance length over mu A and flux, by analogy with Ohm's law.

skills.name: Air gaps in magnetic circuits
skills.description: Show that a small air gap dominates total reluctance, calculate gap flux density for a gapped core, and explain fringing and why gaps stabilize inductance.

skills.name: Permanent magnet operating point with an air gap
skills.description: Combine a magnet's demagnetization curve with the load line of an iron path and air gap to find the magnet's operating point and gap flux density.

skills.name: Back iron, flux concentration and Halbach arrays
skills.description: Explain how back iron, pole pieces and Halbach magnet arrangements steer and concentrate flux into the working gap while limiting leakage and saturation.

skills.name: Inductor core saturation
skills.description: Predict the current at which a cored inductor saturates from its geometry and saturation flux density, and explain the resulting collapse of inductance and current spike.

skills.name: Force from magnetic field energy
skills.description: Derive mechanical force from the change in stored magnetic energy or coenergy with position, including F equals one half i squared dL/dx at constant current.

skills.name: Reluctance force of a solenoid actuator
skills.description: Calculate the pull force across an air gap from B squared A over two mu zero, and explain why solenoid and brake force rises sharply as the gap closes.

skills.name: Reluctance torque
skills.description: Derive torque from the change of inductance with rotor angle and explain how reluctance torque drives switched-reluctance and hybrid stepper motors.

skills.name: Cogging torque
skills.description: Explain how magnets seeking minimum-reluctance positions against stator slots create cogging torque, and how slot-pole combinations and skew reduce it.

skills.name: Torque from interacting rotor and stator fields
skills.description: Model machine torque as proportional to rotor and stator field strengths times the sine of the angle between them, and find the angle giving maximum torque per amp.

skills.name: Rotating magnetic field from three-phase currents
skills.description: Show that three windings spaced 120 degrees and fed balanced three-phase currents produce a constant-magnitude field rotating at synchronous speed.

skills.name: Back-EMF waveform shape
skills.description: Relate a motor's back-EMF waveform to its air-gap flux distribution and winding layout, distinguishing trapezoidal from sinusoidal back-EMF machines.

skills.name: Copper, core and mechanical loss in motors
skills.description: Separate motor losses into copper loss scaling with current squared, core loss scaling with speed and flux, and friction, and predict how each varies across operating points.

skills.name: Gauss's law for magnetism
skills.description: State that net magnetic flux through any closed surface is zero, explain the absence of magnetic monopoles, and use closed flux loops in magnetic reasoning.

skills.name: Displacement current
skills.description: Explain why Ampere's law needs a displacement current term in a charging capacitor and calculate it from the rate of change of electric flux.

skills.name: Maxwell's equations in integral form
skills.description: State the four Maxwell equations in integral form, identify the physical law and sources behind each, and choose the right one for a given field problem.

skills.name: Maxwell's equations in differential form
skills.description: Convert the integral Maxwell equations to divergence and curl form using the divergence and Stokes theorems, and interpret each as a local statement about fields.

skills.name: Wave equation from Maxwell's equations
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Combine Faraday's and Ampere-Maxwell laws in empty space to derive a one-dimensional wave equation for the electric and magnetic fields.

skills.name: Speed of electromagnetic waves
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Compute the speed of light from mu zero and epsilon zero, and find wave speed and wavelength in a dielectric such as cable insulation or PCB substrate.

skills.name: E and B fields in a plane wave
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Describe a plane electromagnetic wave with perpendicular, in-phase E and B fields transverse to propagation, and use E equals c B to relate their amplitudes.

skills.name: Poynting vector and intensity
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Calculate the Poynting vector and time-averaged intensity of an electromagnetic wave, and estimate field amplitude at a distance from an isotropic transmitter's power.

skills.name: Radiation pressure
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Calculate radiation pressure for absorbed and reflected waves from intensity and speed of light, and judge when it is negligible compared with other forces.

skills.name: Radiation from accelerated charge and dipole antennas
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Explain that oscillating charges radiate, size a half-wave dipole for a given frequency, and sketch its doughnut-shaped radiation pattern.

skills.name: Near field versus far field
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Estimate the boundary between reactive near field and radiating far field from wavelength, and explain why near-field coupling is mostly electric or magnetic.

skills.name: Antenna placement in a metal robot body
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Judge how metal frames, batteries, cables and the human body detune or block a robot's Wi-Fi and radio antennas, and choose placements that keep links reliable.

skills.name: Skin effect and skin depth
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Calculate skin depth from resistivity, permeability and frequency, and explain why high-frequency current flows near a conductor's surface.

skills.name: AC resistance, proximity effect and litz wire
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Estimate a wire's AC resistance at a given frequency from skin depth, explain proximity effect between adjacent conductors, and when litz or flat conductors help.

skills.name: Shielding physics: reflection, absorption and magnetic shielding
skills.subdomain: EM waves, skin effect and shielding
skills.description: Explain shielding by reflection and absorption, estimate absorption loss from thickness in skin depths, and why low-frequency magnetic fields need high-permeability shields.

skills.name: Physiological effects of current through the body
skills.description: Describe how perception, let-go, muscle tetany and ventricular fibrillation thresholds depend on current magnitude, duration and AC or DC frequency.

skills.name: Body impedance and touch voltage
skills.description: Estimate current through a person from touch voltage and body plus skin resistance, and explain why wet skin and broken skin raise hazard sharply.

skills.name: Why shock hazard depends on current path
skills.description: Explain why hand-to-hand and hand-to-foot paths through the chest are most dangerous, why a single contact needs a return path, and how ground faults create one.

skills.name: Low-voltage high-current burn and arc hazards
skills.description: Calculate short-circuit current and dissipated power from a battery's internal resistance, and explain why rings, tools and loose wires cause burns at low voltage.

skills.name: Stored-charge hazard in bus capacitors
skills.description: Calculate the energy and discharge time of a robot's bus capacitors through a bleed resistor, and decide when the bus is safe to touch after power-off.

skills.name: Microcontroller families compared
skills.description: Compare AVR/Arduino, ESP32, STM32, RP2040 and Teensy boards by core, clock speed, memory, peripherals, toolchain support and typical robot roles.

skills.name: Choose a microcontroller for a robot node
skills.description: Select a microcontroller for a given robot node by matching required timers, ADC channels, CAN, memory, FPU and real-time load against available parts.

skills.name: Navigate a datasheet and reference manual
skills.description: Find pin functions, electrical limits, peripheral register descriptions and errata in a microcontroller datasheet, reference manual and errata sheet.

skills.name: Plan pin multiplexing and alternate functions
skills.description: Assign peripherals to pins using alternate-function tables, resolving conflicts between timers, serial ports, ADC channels and debug pins before PCB layout.

skills.name: Configure the clock tree and PLL
skills.description: Configure oscillator source, PLL multipliers and bus prescalers so the core and peripheral clocks hit target frequencies, and verify them by measurement.

skills.name: Build and upload with Arduino IDE and PlatformIO
skills.description: Create, compile and upload a firmware project to several board types using the Arduino IDE and a PlatformIO project with pinned library versions.

skills.name: Build bare-metal firmware with GCC and CMake
skills.description: Build an STM32 or RP2040 project with arm-none-eabi-gcc, CMake and vendor SDK or configurator-generated HAL code, controlling optimization and warning flags.

skills.name: Read linker scripts and the memory map
skills.description: Interpret a linker script and map file to see where code, constants, initialized data, BSS, stack and heap live in flash and RAM.

skills.name: Trace the reset and startup sequence
skills.description: Follow execution from reset vector through startup code, data copy, BSS zeroing, clock init and static constructors to main.

skills.name: Flash firmware over USB, serial or DFU bootloaders
skills.description: Flash firmware through built-in ROM bootloaders such as USB DFU, UF2 drag-and-drop or serial boot mode, and recover a board that will not run.

skills.name: Flash and debug through SWD or JTAG
skills.description: Connect an SWD or JTAG probe such as ST-Link, J-Link or a Pico probe, flash images and start an OpenOCD or vendor debug session.

skills.name: Use breakpoints, stepping and watch expressions on target
skills.description: Halt firmware with breakpoints and watchpoints, inspect registers, peripherals and variables live, and recognize when halting disturbs timing-critical hardware.

skills.name: Instrument firmware with printf, RTT and SWO
skills.description: Add low-overhead logging through UART printf, SEGGER RTT or SWO trace, and judge when logging itself changes timing behavior.

skills.name: Debug signals with a logic analyzer
skills.description: Capture and decode GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C and CAN traffic with a logic analyzer, using debug pin toggles to correlate firmware events.

skills.name: Diagnose HardFaults and crashes
skills.description: Decode a Cortex-M HardFault from stacked registers and fault status registers to locate bad pointers, stack overflows and unaligned or invalid accesses.

skills.name: Use volatile for hardware and shared data
skills.description: Explain what volatile does and does not guarantee, and apply it correctly to memory-mapped registers and variables shared with interrupt handlers.

skills.name: Set, clear and test register bits
skills.description: Write set, clear, toggle and field-update operations on peripheral registers using masks and shifts without disturbing neighboring bits.

skills.name: Access peripherals through memory-mapped register structs
skills.description: Read vendor CMSIS headers and access peripherals through base addresses and register struct overlays, including reserved gaps and read-only fields.

skills.name: Avoid integer promotion and overflow bugs
skills.description: Predict results of mixed signed and unsigned arithmetic, integer promotion, shifts and wraparound on 8-, 16- and 32-bit fixed-width types.

skills.name: Design firmware with static allocation
skills.description: Structure firmware so buffers, queues and objects are allocated statically, avoiding heap fragmentation and making RAM use visible at link time.

skills.name: Size the stack and detect overflow
skills.description: Estimate worst-case stack usage from call depth and compiler reports, and detect overflow with stack painting, guard regions or RTOS high-water marks.

skills.name: Protect shared data with critical sections and atomics
skills.description: Protect data shared between interrupts and main code using interrupt masking, atomic types or lock-free single-writer patterns, keeping critical sections short.

skills.name: Use C++ on microcontrollers
skills.description: Write driver classes, templates and constexpr tables in embedded C++ while disabling exceptions and RTTI and avoiding hidden heap allocation.

skills.name: Layer firmware into HAL, drivers and application
skills.description: Separate hardware access, device drivers and application logic behind small interfaces so code can be ported between boards and tested off target.

skills.name: Configure microcontroller GPIO
skills.description: Configure pins as inputs or outputs with correct mode, pull resistors, push-pull or open-drain drive, speed and voltage level, and access them at register level.

skills.name: Debounce switches and limit inputs in firmware
skills.description: Debounce mechanical switches and limit sensors with sampling or timer-based filters, and justify the chosen delay against bounce measurements.

skills.name: Trigger interrupts from pin edges
skills.description: Configure external pin interrupts on rising, falling or both edges, enable them in the interrupt controller and service them correctly.

skills.name: Write safe interrupt service routines
skills.description: Keep ISRs short and non-blocking, clear the right flags, defer work to main code or tasks, and avoid non-reentrant library calls.

skills.name: Assign interrupt priorities and nesting
skills.description: Set interrupt priorities and preemption groups so motor-control interrupts preempt communication interrupts, and reason about worst-case latency.

skills.name: Pass data from ISR to main with a ring buffer
skills.description: Implement a single-producer single-consumer ring buffer that safely moves bytes or samples from an interrupt handler to background code.

skills.name: Calculate timer prescaler and period values
skills.description: Compute prescaler and auto-reload values that give a requested tick rate or interrupt frequency, and quantify resulting frequency error.

skills.name: Generate PWM with hardware timers
skills.description: Configure a timer channel in PWM mode with a chosen frequency, resolution and polarity, and update duty cycle from firmware without glitches.

skills.name: Drive hobby servos with timed pulses
skills.description: Generate standard 50 Hz servo pulses with microsecond resolution and map joint angle commands to pulse widths with calibrated endpoints.

skills.name: Generate complementary PWM with dead time
skills.description: Configure center-aligned complementary PWM outputs with hardware dead time and break input for half-bridge and three-phase drivers.

skills.name: Measure pulses with input capture
skills.description: Use timer input capture to measure pulse width, period and frequency of external signals, handling counter overflow between edges.

skills.name: Write brushed motor driver firmware
skills.description: Command an H-bridge from firmware with direction, PWM duty, braking and coasting modes, ramped commands and a safe default output.

skills.name: Configure and read the ADC
skills.description: Configure ADC resolution, channel, sampling time and reference, then convert raw counts to calibrated volts and engineering units.

skills.name: Move data with DMA
skills.description: Set up a DMA channel to move peripheral data to memory without CPU involvement, handling transfer-complete interrupts and buffer alignment.

skills.name: Stream ADC samples with circular DMA
skills.description: Stream multichannel ADC conversions into a circular buffer with half- and full-transfer interrupts so processing never overwrites live data.

skills.name: Trigger ADC sampling from a timer
skills.description: Trigger ADC conversions from a timer event so samples are evenly spaced and synchronized to PWM, removing software timing jitter.

skills.name: Read motor current with offset calibration
skills.description: Sample shunt current sensor outputs synchronized to PWM, calibrate zero offset at startup and convert counts to amps with gain checks.

skills.name: Read a quadrature encoder in firmware
skills.description: Decode quadrature A/B signals using a timer encoder mode or interrupt state machine, giving signed counts with correct direction.

skills.name: Extend encoder counts and handle index pulses
skills.description: Extend a 16-bit hardware counter into a 32- or 64-bit position with wraparound handling, and use the index pulse to reference zero.

skills.name: Estimate velocity from encoder counts
skills.description: Estimate joint velocity from encoder data by count differencing or edge timing, and choose filtering to balance noise and lag at low speed.

skills.name: Read absolute encoders over SPI, SSI or I2C
skills.description: Read angle data from magnetic or SSI absolute encoders such as AS5047, AS5600 or BiSS units, check parity, CRC and error flags, and convert to radians.

skills.name: Calibrate absolute encoder offset and eccentricity
skills.description: Store a mechanical zero offset for an absolute encoder and compensate magnet eccentricity with a lookup table measured against a reference.

skills.name: Combine motor and output encoders
skills.description: Combine a motor-side incremental encoder and an output-side absolute encoder to get absolute joint position at power-up and detect transmission slip.

skills.name: Read Hall sensors for commutation and speed
skills.description: Read three Hall sensor inputs, map them to a six-step sector and estimate rotor speed from transition timing.

skills.name: Write an interrupt-driven UART driver
skills.description: Implement UART transmit and receive with interrupts or DMA and ring buffers, handling baud configuration, framing errors and overruns.

skills.name: Write an I2C master driver with error recovery
skills.description: Perform I2C register reads and writes with repeated starts, handle NACKs, clock stretching and timeouts, and recover a stuck bus.

skills.name: Write an SPI driver with correct mode and chip select
skills.description: Configure SPI clock polarity, phase, bit order and speed for a device, manage chip select timing and use DMA for longer transfers.

skills.name: Configure a CAN controller and bit timing
skills.description: Calculate CAN bit timing segments for a target bitrate and sample point, and configure the controller, transceiver and acceptance filters.

skills.name: Send and receive CAN frames in firmware
skills.description: Transmit and receive standard and extended CAN frames through mailboxes or FIFOs with interrupts, and handle error-passive and bus-off states.

skills.name: Encode binary messages with explicit layout
skills.description: Serialize structs into byte arrays with explicit field order, sizes and endianness instead of relying on compiler struct packing.

skills.name: Frame packets on a byte stream with COBS or SLIP
skills.description: Delimit packets on a serial byte stream using COBS, SLIP or start-length framing so receivers resynchronize after lost or corrupted bytes.

skills.name: Implement CRC checks in firmware
skills.description: Implement table-driven or hardware CRC-8, CRC-16 or CRC-32, match a reference implementation's parameters and test known check values.

skills.name: Parse a byte stream with a receive state machine
skills.description: Build a non-blocking receive state machine that validates framing, length and CRC, rejects malformed packets and counts errors.

skills.name: Design command and status messages for a joint controller
skills.description: Define command messages for mode, position, velocity, torque and gains, and status messages for position, velocity, current, temperature and faults.

skills.name: Allocate node IDs and CAN identifiers
skills.description: Assign node IDs and CAN arbitration identifiers so safety and command messages win arbitration and many joints share one bus without conflict.

skills.name: Implement heartbeat and command timeouts
skills.description: Send periodic heartbeats and enforce command timeouts so a joint controller enters a safe state when its host or bus link goes silent.

skills.name: Add sequence counters and protocol versioning
skills.description: Add sequence counters to detect lost or stale messages and a protocol version field so mismatched host and firmware versions are rejected.

skills.name: Budget bus bandwidth and update rates
skills.description: Calculate CAN or serial bus load for all joints at chosen message sizes and rates, including bit stuffing overhead, and keep margin.

skills.name: Write a host-side driver for a bus of joint controllers
skills.description: Write host software that enumerates joints, sends synchronized commands, collects status replies and reports timeouts and faults per joint.

skills.name: Choose superloop, interrupt-driven or RTOS architecture
skills.description: Compare superloop, timer-interrupt-driven and RTOS firmware architectures for a joint controller by timing determinism, complexity and responsiveness.

skills.name: Run a fixed-rate control loop on a microcontroller
skills.description: Run sensing, control and actuation at a fixed rate from a hardware timer tick, keeping the loop period constant regardless of computation time.

skills.name: Measure execution time with cycle counters and pin toggles
skills.description: Measure code execution time using the cycle counter or a GPIO pin toggled around a section and timed with an oscilloscope.

skills.name: Measure and reduce loop jitter
skills.description: Record loop start timestamps, compute jitter statistics and histograms, and reduce jitter by moving work out of interrupts or raising priority.

skills.name: Schedule multi-rate cascaded loops
skills.description: Run current, velocity and position loops at different integer-related rates from one timebase, passing setpoints between them consistently.

skills.name: Create FreeRTOS tasks with priorities and stacks
skills.description: Create FreeRTOS tasks with chosen priorities and stack sizes, use periodic delays for fixed-rate tasks and check the scheduler runs as intended.

skills.name: Pass messages between tasks with queues
skills.description: Use RTOS queues and task notifications to pass data between tasks and from ISRs with the correct from-ISR API variants.

skills.name: Protect resources with mutexes and semaphores
