skills.description: Choose bearing type, size and arrangement for a robot joint from its loads and life, then specify fits, axial location and mounting steps.

skills.name: Crossed-roller and thin-section output bearings
skills.description: Use a single crossed-roller or thin-section four-point bearing to carry the moment loads of a compact joint output, including clamping and tilt stiffness.

skills.name: Axially locate shafts and bearings
skills.description: Locate bearings and hubs with shoulders, spacers, grooved retaining rings, locknuts and collars, checking ring thrust capacity so axial loads have a defined path.

skills.name: Select a shaft coupling
skills.description: Distinguish parallel, angular and axial misalignment and select rigid, jaw, beam, Oldham or bellows couplings by torque, torsional stiffness and backlash.

skills.name: Attach gears and pulleys to shafts
skills.description: Transmit torque to hubs with keys, D-flats, set screws or clamp hubs, sizing a key for shear while avoiding radial overload of motor bearings.

skills.name: Mobility of planar mechanisms
skills.description: Count the degrees of freedom of planar linkages with the Gruebler-Kutzbach equation and identify overconstrained or underactuated layouts.

skills.name: Four-bar linkage analysis
skills.description: Classify four-bar linkages with the Grashof condition, solve link angles, and evaluate transmission angle and coupler motion through the range.

skills.name: Parallelogram linkages in robot arms
skills.description: Use parallelogram linkages to hold a link orientation or move a heavy motor toward the base, and check toggle and singular positions.

skills.name: Select compression, extension and torsion springs
skills.description: Calculate spring rate, solid height and maximum stress for compression, extension and torsion springs and select stock springs from catalogs.

skills.name: Counterbalance a link against gravity
skills.description: Design a spring or counterweight counterbalance that cancels a link's gravity torque over its range, and compare added inertia and complexity.

skills.name: Bevel differential for two-axis joints
skills.description: Analyse a bevel-gear differential that combines two motors into pitch and roll of a wrist or neck, deriving the joint-to-motor velocity mapping.

skills.name: Design for stiffness, not just strength
skills.description: Explain why robot structures are usually deflection-limited and set stiffness targets from allowable tip error before checking stress margins.

skills.name: Efficient sections and materials for stiffness
skills.description: Compare tube, box and plate sections and materials by bending and torsional stiffness per unit mass using specific-stiffness material indices.

skills.name: Tip deflection through a chain of compliances
skills.description: Combine link bending, joint bearing tilt and gearbox torsional compliance in series to predict end-effector deflection under payload.

skills.name: Natural frequency of a robot link
skills.description: Estimate the first natural frequency of a link carrying a payload and check it sits well above the intended control bandwidth.

skills.name: Lightweight with pockets, ribs and hollows
skills.description: Remove mass with pockets, ribs, hollowing and tube structures while tracking the resulting stiffness change and manufacturing cost.

skills.name: Fatigue check for cyclically loaded parts
skills.description: Check a repeatedly loaded robot part with an S-N approach, stress concentration factors and a Goodman line to estimate safe cycle life.

skills.name: Set up a linear static FEA study
skills.description: Prepare geometry, materials, mesh, realistic bolted and bearing supports and remote loads for a CAD-integrated static study without artificial singularities.

skills.name: Interpret FEA stress and displacement
skills.description: Read displacement and von Mises results, recognise singularities, run a mesh convergence check and judge margins against the failure criterion.

skills.name: Validate FEA against hand calculation and test
skills.description: Compare FEA results with a beam hand calculation and a measured deflection test, explain discrepancies and adjust the model.

skills.name: Topology optimization to manufacturable geometry
skills.description: Set up a topology optimization with loads, keep-out regions and mass targets, then reinterpret the result into printable or machinable geometry.

skills.name: Estimate impact and fall loads
skills.description: Estimate peak forces from bumps, collisions and falls using impulse and stiffness, and design compliant stops or crumple features to limit them.

skills.name: FDM printing process and materials
skills.description: Explain how an FDM printer builds parts from extruded layers and compare PLA, PETG, ASA, nylon and fiber-filled filaments for robot parts.

skills.name: Configure slicer settings for strength and accuracy
skills.description: Set layer height, wall count, infill, top layers, supports and speeds in a slicer, and predict their effect on strength, accuracy and print time.

skills.name: Design rules for printable parts
skills.description: Design parts with self-supporting overhangs, bridges, teardrop holes, minimum wall thickness and chamfers on the bed face so they print without support.

skills.name: Print orientation and layer anisotropy
skills.description: Choose print orientation so principal stresses run along extrusion lines rather than across weak layer bonds, trading strength against support and finish.

skills.name: Tolerance printed holes, shafts and fits
skills.description: Print calibration coupons and apply measured offsets for slip, press and bearing fits so printed parts assemble with predictable clearance.

skills.name: Diagnose and calibrate print defects
skills.description: Diagnose warping, stringing, under-extrusion, layer shifts and dimensional error, and calibrate flow, temperature and shrinkage compensation.

skills.name: Design and print functional parts with tolerances
skills.description: Design, orient, slice and print load-bearing brackets and housings that meet fit tolerances and strength requirements on the first or second attempt.

skills.name: Choose filament for creep, heat and impact
skills.description: Select printing material for a robot part from creep under bolt preload, heat near motors, impact toughness and stiffness requirements.

skills.name: Design and print gears
skills.description: Generate involute spur and herringbone gears for printing, set backlash and tooth size for the material, and check tooth bending stress limits.

skills.name: Printed compliant hinges and flexures
skills.description: Design printed flexure hinges and compliant mechanisms by keeping bending strain below the material limit and orienting layers along the flex direction.

skills.name: Resin printing for small precise parts
skills.description: Print small, detailed parts on a resin printer with suitable supports, washing and post-curing, and handle uncured resin safely.

skills.name: Machine shop safety
skills.description: Apply machine shop safety: guarding, eye and hearing protection, chip handling, loose clothing rules and safe setup before running any machine.

skills.name: Drill, ream and tap holes
skills.description: Drill holes to size on a drill press, ream for accurate fits, and tap threads with correct tap drill size, lubrication and alignment.

skills.name: Calculate cutting speeds and feeds
skills.description: Compute spindle speed from surface speed and tool diameter and feed rate from chip load and flute count for aluminum, steel and plastics.

skills.name: Workholding with vises, clamps and fixtures
skills.description: Hold parts rigidly and repeatably with vises, parallels, soft jaws, clamps and simple fixtures referenced to datums.

skills.name: Operate a manual milling machine
skills.description: Tram the head, indicate the vise, find edges and square stock on a manual mill, then cut pockets and slots to drawing tolerances.

skills.name: Turn parts on a lathe
skills.description: Face, turn, bore, groove and part off on a lathe to make shafts, spacers and bushings, holding diameters to bearing-fit tolerances.

skills.name: Program CAM toolpaths
skills.description: Set stock, work coordinate system and tools, then program facing, adaptive clearing, contour, pocket and drilling toolpaths in CAM software.

skills.name: Set up and run a CNC mill
skills.description: Read basic G-code, set work offsets and tool lengths, simulate and dry-run a program, and inspect the first part before production.

skills.name: Design parts for machining
skills.description: Design machined parts with tool-accessible features, internal corner radii, minimal setups and realistic tolerances to cut cost and lead time.

skills.name: Bend allowance and K-factor
skills.description: Calculate bend allowance and bend deduction from thickness, inside radius and K-factor, and respect minimum flange length and hole-to-bend distance.

skills.name: Develop a sheet metal flat pattern
skills.description: Develop a flat pattern for a bent bracket by hand and in CAD, adding bend and corner reliefs so it forms without tearing.

skills.name: Model sheet metal parts in CAD
skills.description: Model brackets and enclosures with base flanges, edge flanges, hems and reliefs using sheet-metal CAD features and export the flat pattern as DXF.

skills.name: Laser, plasma and waterjet cutting
skills.description: Choose between laser, plasma and waterjet cutting by material, thickness, kerf, edge quality and heat-affected zone, and prepare files for a cutting service.

skills.name: Bend parts on a press brake
skills.description: Plan bend sequence, select tooling and bend sheet parts on a press brake or bending brake, checking angles and springback.

skills.name: Weld joint types and weld symbols
skills.description: Choose butt, fillet, lap and corner joints and read and write weld symbols on drawings so a weldment is specified unambiguously.

skills.name: Size fillet welds for load
skills.description: Calculate fillet weld throat stress for direct and eccentric loads and size welds with appropriate allowable stress and safety factor.

skills.name: TIG weld thin aluminum
skills.description: TIG weld thin aluminum sections with correct AC balance, cleaning, filler choice and heat control, and recognise the strength loss in the heat-affected zone.

skills.name: Control welding distortion
skills.description: Control distortion with fixturing, tack and weld sequencing, balanced heat input and post-weld machining so frames stay square and flat.

skills.name: Braze and silver-solder joints
skills.description: Braze or silver-solder small steel, brass and copper parts with correct joint clearance, flux and heating for sealed or low-distortion joints.

skills.name: Design and make structural adhesive joints
skills.description: Select epoxy, acrylic or cyanoacrylate adhesives, prepare surfaces and design joints that load the adhesive in shear rather than peel.

skills.name: Bond carbon-fiber tubes into fittings
skills.description: Join carbon-fiber tubes to aluminum or printed fittings with bonded sleeves and clamps, sizing bond length and protecting tubes from crushing.

skills.name: Measure with calipers
skills.description: Measure outside, inside, depth and step dimensions with vernier, dial and digital calipers, avoiding Abbe and tilt errors.

skills.name: Measure with micrometers
skills.description: Read outside, inside and depth micrometers, check zero with standards, and measure bearing journals and bores to the micron range.

skills.name: Dial and test indicators
skills.description: Use dial and test indicators on stands to measure runout, alignment, flatness and structural deflection under known loads.

skills.name: Datum setup on a surface plate
skills.description: Set up a part on a surface plate with angle plates and V-blocks to simulate datums, then check height, squareness and flatness with a height gauge and indicator.

skills.name: First-article inspection report
skills.description: Inspect a part against every drawing callout, record measurements in a balloon-numbered report and decide accept, rework or reject.

skills.name: Design for assembly principles
skills.description: Reduce part and fastener count, add self-locating features, assemble from one direction and add error-proofing so robots go together correctly.

skills.name: Design for service and modular replacement
skills.description: Make joints and electronics replaceable as modules with accessible fasteners, connectors and service loops, minimising teardown for common repairs.

skills.name: Route cables through rotating joints
skills.description: Route wiring through or around joints with hollow shafts, service loops or clock-spring coils while respecting bend radius and twist limits over the joint range.

skills.name: Slip rings and hollow-shaft continuous rotation
skills.description: Decide between limited twist and slip rings for continuous rotation, and integrate a through-bore slip ring with a hollow-shaft bearing layout.

skills.name: Write assembly procedures with torque specs
skills.description: Write step-by-step assembly instructions with exploded views, torque values, threadlocker notes and checkpoints that another builder can follow.

skills.name: Run a mechanical design review
skills.description: Review a mechanical design against requirements with a checklist covering loads, fits, assembly, service, safety and manufacturing before release.

skills.name: Design electronics enclosures
skills.description: Design enclosures with suitable wall thickness, mounting bosses, connector cut-outs, ventilation and cable entry for robot electronics.

skills.name: Design snap-fit joints
skills.description: Size cantilever snap-fit hooks from allowable strain and assembly force so covers clip on and off repeatedly without breaking.

skills.name: Proportions and silhouette for a friendly droid
skills.description: Apply industrial design principles of proportion, silhouette, visual weight and rounded forms to sketch a protocol droid that reads as approachable.

skills.name: Scale a humanoid from anthropometric data
skills.description: Use anthropometric tables to set link lengths, shoulder width, eye height and reach so the droid works at human tables and conversational heights.

skills.name: Split shells into printable panels
skills.description: Split body shells into printable panels with parting lines, hidden fastening, alignment features and gaps that tolerate print variation.

skills.name: Eliminate pinch points and finger traps
skills.description: Identify pinch and shear points around moving joints and design gaps, guards and limited openings that keep fingers out of harm.

skills.name: Design mechanical end stops
skills.description: Add hard stops with compliant bumpers beyond the software limits of a joint, sized to absorb the energy of a full-speed overrun.

skills.name: Design an actuator joint housing and output stage
skills.description: Design a joint housing that locates motor, reduction, encoder and output bearing, routing external output loads through the bearing into the housing rather than the gearbox.

skills.name: Thermal path from motor to housing
skills.description: Estimate motor winding temperature through a thermal resistance path into the housing and add conduction paths or vents where it overheats.

skills.name: Arm mass distribution and joint torque
skills.description: Place motors and heavy parts close to the shoulder to reduce gravity and inertia torques, and compute payload capacity from CAD mass properties.

skills.name: Design arm links and link-to-joint interfaces
skills.description: Design links from tube, plate or printed shells with stiff, repeatable interfaces to joint outputs and routes for cables between joints.

skills.name: Design a lightweight robot arm structure
skills.description: Design a full arm structure that meets reach, payload, stiffness and mass targets, verified by tip deflection estimates and CAD mass properties.

skills.name: Cable management along a robot
skills.description: Route and secure harnesses along links with clips, channels and strain relief so cables never carry load or rub on moving edges.

skills.name: Verify a built arm against its design
skills.description: Measure joint play, structural deflection and range of motion on an assembled arm and compare them with CAD and stiffness predictions.

skills.name: Rigid, repeatable sensor mounts
skills.description: Design mounts for cameras, lidar and IMUs that are stiff, vibration-tolerant and repeatable after removal so calibrations survive service.

skills.name: Design a wheeled base chassis
skills.description: Design a mobile base chassis with drive wheels supported on their own bearings, casters, low centre of mass, battery bay, bumpers and a stiff deck.

skills.name: Protective covers and soft padding
skills.description: Design removable covers and padding over joints and electronics that protect people and parts without restricting motion or cooling.

skills.name: Design a compact robot wrist
skills.description: Design a two- or three-axis wrist using serial joints or a differential, minimising length and offset while routing cables to the hand.

skills.name: Design a pan-tilt neck and head
skills.description: Design a two-axis neck that carries cameras, microphones and a face display with low backlash, quiet motion and cables routed through the axes.

skills.name: Design a humanoid shoulder cluster
skills.description: Arrange three shoulder axes with intersecting or offset joint axes, shoulder width and range of motion suited to bimanual work in front of the torso.

skills.name: Design a humanoid torso frame
skills.description: Design a torso frame that carries both shoulders and the neck, houses electronics and transfers arm loads into the base with adequate stiffness.

skills.name: Design a humanoid torso, shoulder and head structure
skills.description: Integrate torso frame, two shoulder clusters, neck and head shells into one upper-body structure that meets mass, stiffness, reach and service targets.

skills.name: Design a hip and pelvis structure
skills.description: Design a pelvis and three-axis hip that carries body weight and walking moments through large bearings into stiff, compact leg mounts.

skills.name: Design legs for walking loads
skills.description: Design thigh and shank structures with knee actuator placement and low distal mass, sized for repeated impacts and fatigue during walking.

skills.name: Sensor transfer function, range and sensitivity
skills.description: Read a sensor's transfer curve to state its measurement range, sensitivity, offset and saturation limits, and convert raw readings into physical units.

skills.name: Resolution and quantization error
skills.description: Calculate the smallest detectable change of a digitized sensor from its bit depth and range, and bound the resulting quantization error in physical units.

skills.name: Measure a sensor noise floor from a static log
skills.description: Record a stationary sensor, compute mean, standard deviation and histogram of the readings, and separate random noise from offset and slow drift.

skills.name: Sensor bandwidth and step response
skills.description: Relate a sensor's bandwidth, time constant and internal filtering to how quickly it follows a step change, and recognize when it is too slow for a control loop.

skills.name: Measure end-to-end sensor latency
skills.description: Measure the delay between a physical event and its arrival in software using a stimulus such as an LED or tap, and separate exposure, transfer and processing delays.

skills.name: Smooth sensor data with averaging and median filters
skills.description: Implement moving-average, exponential and median filters on streaming samples, and quantify noise reduction, spike rejection and added lag for each.

skills.name: Encoder resolution and velocity estimation
skills.description: Compute angular resolution of an encoder through a gearbox and estimate joint velocity by counting edges per interval or timing between edges, choosing by speed range.

skills.name: Read an absolute encoder and establish joint zero
skills.description: Read an absolute magnetic encoder over SPI or I2C, handle wrap-around, and define a repeatable joint zero that survives power cycles and reassembly.

skills.name: Measure motor current with a shunt and amplifier
skills.description: Size a shunt resistor and differential amplifier for motor phase or supply current, and sample it synchronized with PWM to avoid switching artefacts.

skills.name: Estimate joint torque from motor current
skills.description: Convert measured motor current into output torque using the torque constant and gear ratio, and account for friction and efficiency losses that bias the estimate.

skills.name: Read a strain-gauge load cell through a bridge amplifier
skills.description: Wire a strain-gauge load cell to a bridge amplifier ADC, tare and calibrate it with known masses, and assess creep and temperature drift.

skills.name: Use a six-axis force-torque sensor at the wrist
skills.description: Read a six-axis force-torque sensor, remove bias, compensate the gravity of the attached tool, and express the wrench in the end-effector frame.

skills.name: Sense joint torque from strain or deflection
skills.description: Measure joint torque with in-joint strain gauges, series-elastic spring deflection, or the difference between motor-side and output-side encoders across the gearbox.

skills.name: MEMS accelerometer and specific force
skills.description: Explain that a MEMS accelerometer measures specific force, so a stationary sensor reads gravity, and predict readings for given orientations and accelerations.

skills.name: MEMS gyroscope rate measurement and bias
skills.description: Explain how a MEMS gyroscope measures angular rate, and describe bias, scale-factor error and noise and how each corrupts an integrated angle.

skills.name: Read and scale raw IMU data
skills.description: Configure an IMU's range and output data rate over I2C or SPI, read raw registers, and convert counts to metres per second squared and radians per second.

skills.name: Compute roll and pitch from an accelerometer
skills.description: Compute roll and pitch from a static accelerometer reading using atan2, and explain why linear acceleration and missing yaw limit this estimate.

skills.name: Integrate gyroscope rate and quantify drift
skills.description: Integrate sampled angular rate to obtain angle, and predict and measure the angle drift caused by an uncorrected gyroscope bias over time.

skills.name: Calibrate IMU bias and scale factors
skills.description: Estimate gyroscope bias from a still period and accelerometer bias and scale with a multi-position test, then apply and verify the corrections.

skills.name: Calibrate a magnetometer and compute heading
skills.description: Fit hard- and soft-iron corrections to magnetometer data collected over many orientations, compute heading, and recognize distortion from motors and steel frames.

skills.name: Fuse gyro and accelerometer tilt with a complementary filter
skills.description: Blend high-passed gyroscope integration with low-passed accelerometer tilt, choose the crossover time constant, and test the result during motion.

skills.name: Quaternions for orientation and rate integration
skills.description: Multiply, normalize and invert unit quaternions, convert them to rotation matrices, and integrate body angular rate into a quaternion orientation.

skills.name: Estimate attitude with a Madgwick or Mahony filter
skills.description: Run a Madgwick or Mahony filter on gyroscope, accelerometer and optional magnetometer data, tune its gain, and compare drift against a complementary filter.

skills.name: Estimate orientation from an IMU
skills.description: Deliver a quaternion orientation estimate from a calibrated IMU aligned to the robot body frame, publish it in ROS 2, and validate it against known poses.

skills.name: Measure range with an ultrasonic sensor
skills.description: Trigger an ultrasonic ranger, convert echo time to distance with temperature-corrected sound speed, and map its beam width and minimum range.

skills.name: Read a single-point optical time-of-flight sensor
skills.description: Configure a laser time-of-flight distance sensor for range and timing budget, read distances, and measure accuracy across target colours and distances.

skills.name: Range sensor failure modes
skills.description: Predict range errors from specular surfaces, glass, dark absorbers, multipath, sunlight and crosstalk between sensors, and design tests that expose them.

skills.name: Convert 2D lidar scans to Cartesian points
skills.description: Interpret a 2D laser scan's angle increment, range limits and invalid values, filter bad returns, and convert ranges into points in sensor and robot frames.

skills.name: 3D lidar scan structure and motion distortion
skills.description: Describe how multi-beam 3D lidars build point clouds from rings, convert returns with spherical coordinates, and correct scan distortion from robot motion during a sweep.

skills.name: Digital images as arrays of pixels
skills.description: Represent images as height-by-width-by-channel arrays, index pixels and regions, and explain bit depth, data type and memory size of an image.

skills.name: Colour spaces and conversions
skills.description: Convert images between RGB, BGR, grayscale and HSV, and explain why hue-based spaces are more robust for colour segmentation under changing brightness.

skills.name: Load, process and display images with OpenCV
skills.description: Use OpenCV to read and write images and video, draw overlays, crop, resize and convert colour, and display results interactively in a script.

skills.name: Capture camera frames and measure frame rate
skills.description: Open a USB camera, set resolution, frame rate and exposure properties, grab frames in a loop, and measure the actual frame rate and dropped frames.

skills.name: Image histograms and contrast adjustment
skills.description: Compute intensity histograms, diagnose under- and over-exposure, and apply contrast stretching, gamma correction and adaptive equalization.

skills.name: Discrete 2D convolution and kernels
skills.description: Compute a 2D convolution by hand and in code, handle borders, and predict the effect of a small kernel on an image.

skills.name: Box, Gaussian and median blur
skills.description: Apply box, Gaussian and median blurs, relate Gaussian sigma to kernel size, and choose a filter for sensor noise versus salt-and-pepper noise.

skills.name: Image gradients and edge detection
skills.description: Compute Sobel gradients, magnitude and direction, and run Canny edge detection with suitable thresholds to extract clean object boundaries.

skills.name: Threshold images by intensity and colour
skills.description: Build binary masks with fixed, adaptive, Otsu and HSV colour thresholds, combine masks with bitwise operations, and choose a method for uneven lighting.

skills.name: Morphological operations on binary images
skills.description: Apply erosion, dilation, opening and closing with chosen structuring elements to remove specks, fill holes and separate touching regions.

skills.name: Contours, connected components and shape properties
skills.description: Extract contours and connected components from a binary mask and compute area, centroid, bounding box, orientation and image moments of each region.

skills.name: Lens focal length, sensor size and field of view
skills.description: Calculate horizontal and vertical field of view from focal length and sensor size, and choose a lens for a required working distance and coverage.

skills.name: Image sensors, exposure and gain
skills.description: Explain how CMOS photosites and Bayer filters form colour images, and trade exposure time, gain and aperture against noise, motion blur and depth of field.

skills.name: Rolling versus global shutter
skills.description: Explain row-by-row readout in rolling-shutter sensors, predict skew under fast motion or vibration, and decide when a global shutter is required.

skills.name: Select cameras for a robot head and body
skills.description: Choose cameras, lenses, shutters and interfaces for navigation, manipulation and face-to-face interaction from field of view, resolution, bandwidth and latency needs.

skills.name: Homogeneous coordinates for projection
skills.description: Represent 2D and 3D points in homogeneous coordinates, apply projective transforms as matrix products, and normalize back to Euclidean coordinates.

skills.name: Pinhole camera model and projection
skills.description: Project 3D points into pixels with the pinhole model, building the intrinsic matrix from focal lengths in pixels and principal point, and handle points behind the camera.

skills.name: Back-project pixels to rays and 3D points
skills.description: Invert the intrinsic matrix to turn a pixel into a viewing ray, and recover a 3D point when its depth or a supporting plane is known.

skills.name: Radial and tangential lens distortion
skills.description: Apply the polynomial radial and tangential distortion model, undistort images and points, and recognize when a fisheye model is needed instead.

skills.name: Calibrate a camera
skills.description: Capture checkerboard or ChArUco views with good coverage, estimate intrinsics and distortion in OpenCV, and accept the result using per-view reprojection error.

skills.name: Camera extrinsics in the robot transform tree
skills.description: Express a camera's pose relative to the robot with the optical-frame convention and add it to the tf2 tree so pixels map into robot coordinates.

skills.name: Publish images and camera info in ROS 2
skills.description: Run a ROS 2 camera driver publishing images and calibration info, convert messages with cv_bridge, and rectify images with image_proc.

skills.name: Stereo baseline, disparity and depth
skills.description: Compute depth from disparity for a rectified stereo pair using similar triangles, and show that depth error grows with the square of distance.

skills.name: Epipolar geometry and the essential matrix
skills.description: Explain the epipolar constraint, compute epipolar lines from essential and fundamental matrices, and use them to restrict correspondence search.

skills.name: Rectify a stereo pair and compute disparity
skills.description: Calibrate two cameras jointly, rectify them so epipolar lines are horizontal, and compute disparity with semi-global matching, filtering invalid pixels.

skills.name: Structured-light and active stereo depth
skills.description: Explain how projected infrared patterns create texture for depth triangulation, and predict failures in sunlight, on shiny surfaces and at close range.

skills.name: Time-of-flight depth cameras
skills.description: Explain continuous-wave phase measurement in time-of-flight cameras and predict range ambiguity, multipath and flying-pixel artefacts.

skills.name: Align depth images to the colour camera
skills.description: Use depth and colour intrinsics with their extrinsic transform to register depth onto colour pixels, and handle occlusion holes and resolution mismatch.

skills.name: Run and tune an RGB-D camera
skills.description: Run an RGB-D camera driver in ROS 2, choose resolution and depth presets, enable spatial and temporal filters, and verify depth against measured distances.

skills.name: Detect fiducial markers (AprilTag, ArUco)
skills.description: Detect AprilTag or ArUco markers, decode their IDs, estimate each marker's pose from known size and calibration, and judge pose reliability by distance and angle.

skills.name: Corners and keypoint descriptors (ORB, SIFT)
skills.description: Detect Harris and FAST corners, compute ORB and SIFT descriptors, and compare their invariance to scale and rotation, speed and matching cost.

skills.name: Match features between images
skills.description: Match descriptors with brute-force and approximate nearest-neighbour search, filter with the ratio test and cross-check, and visualize good and bad matches.

skills.name: Robust model fitting with RANSAC
skills.description: Implement RANSAC to fit a line or plane amid outliers, and compute the iterations needed for a given inlier ratio and confidence.

skills.name: Estimate and apply a homography
skills.description: Estimate a homography between two views of a plane from matched points with RANSAC, and use it to warp images or map table pixels to table coordinates.

skills.name: Estimate camera pose with PnP
skills.description: Solve the perspective-n-point problem from 2D-3D correspondences with RANSAC, check reprojection error, and express the object pose in the robot frame.

skills.name: Optical flow with Lucas-Kanade and dense methods
skills.description: Track points between frames with pyramidal Lucas-Kanade, compute dense flow, and explain the brightness-constancy assumption and the aperture problem.

skills.name: Estimate motion with visual odometry
skills.description: Build a frame-to-frame visual odometry pipeline from feature tracking, outlier rejection and pose estimation, and measure its drift over a known path.

skills.name: Classify images with a pretrained network
skills.description: Run a pretrained convolutional or transformer classifier on camera frames with correct preprocessing, and interpret top-k scores and their calibration.

skills.name: Bounding boxes, IoU and non-maximum suppression
skills.description: Compute intersection over union between boxes, apply confidence thresholds and non-maximum suppression, and explain anchor-based and anchor-free detectors.

skills.name: Detect objects with a neural network detector
skills.description: Run a YOLO-family detector on live camera frames, filter detections by class and confidence, and publish labelled boxes for downstream robot behaviours.

skills.name: Evaluate detectors with precision, recall and mAP
skills.description: Compute precision, recall and mean average precision on a labelled set, and choose an operating threshold from the cost of misses versus false alarms.

skills.name: Collect and label an image dataset
skills.description: Capture robot images covering viewpoints, lighting and backgrounds, annotate boxes and masks to written guidelines, audit labels, and split without leakage.

skills.name: Fine-tune an object detector on custom data
skills.description: Fine-tune a pretrained detector on custom labelled data with realistic augmentation, monitor validation metrics, and compare against the base model on held-out robot images.

skills.name: Instance segmentation masks
skills.description: Run an instance segmentation model to obtain per-object masks, and use masks rather than boxes to compute object extent and grasp regions.

skills.name: Human body keypoint and pose estimation
skills.description: Run a 2D human pose estimator to obtain body keypoints with confidences, and handle partial occlusion and multiple people in the frame.

skills.name: Open-vocabulary object detection
skills.description: Detect objects named in free text with an open-vocabulary detector, tune prompts and thresholds, and verify reliability before letting it drive robot actions.

skills.name: Describe scenes with a vision-language model
skills.description: Query a vision-language model to describe a scene or answer questions about it, constrain outputs to structured formats, and check answers against geometric perception.

skills.name: Lift 2D detections into 3D positions
skills.description: Combine detection boxes or masks with aligned depth to compute 3D object positions in the robot frame, rejecting background and invalid depth pixels.

skills.name: Track detections across frames
skills.description: Associate detections over time with a Kalman motion model and assignment by IoU or distance, maintaining stable track IDs through brief misses.

skills.name: Build and process point clouds from depth
skills.description: Convert depth images into organized and unorganized point clouds with colour, store and visualize them, and crop them to a region of interest.

skills.name: Downsample and denoise point clouds
skills.description: Apply voxel-grid downsampling, pass-through cropping and statistical or radius outlier removal, and choose voxel size for speed versus detail.

skills.name: Estimate surface normals in a point cloud
skills.description: Estimate per-point normals from local neighbourhood covariance, orient them consistently toward the sensor, and pick neighbourhood radius for noisy depth.

skills.name: Segment planes with RANSAC
skills.description: Fit and remove dominant planes such as floors and tables from a point cloud with RANSAC, and extract the points that lie above a support surface.

skills.name: Cluster point clouds into objects
skills.description: Group points into object clusters with k-d tree neighbour search or DBSCAN, filter by size, and fit centroids and oriented bounding boxes.

skills.name: Align point clouds with ICP
skills.description: Register two point clouds with point-to-point and point-to-plane ICP, explain its need for a good initial guess, and evaluate fitness and residual error.

skills.name: Estimate 6D object pose
skills.description: Estimate an object's full position and orientation by fitting a CAD model to segmented points or using a learned pose estimator, and verify the pose before grasping.

skills.name: Use point clouds in ROS 2
skills.description: Publish and subscribe PointCloud2 messages, transform clouds into the base frame with tf2, and visualize them in RViz while monitoring message size and rate.

skills.name: Remove the robot's own body from sensor data
skills.description: Use the robot description and current joint states to mask out points and scan returns that hit the robot's own arms, head or base.

skills.name: Build an occupancy grid with log-odds updates
skills.description: Ray-trace lidar beams from known poses through a grid and update free and occupied cell beliefs with log-odds Bayesian updates.

skills.name: Align consecutive lidar scans
skills.description: Estimate relative robot motion by aligning consecutive 2D lidar scans with ICP or correlative matching, and detect degenerate cases such as long featureless corridors.

skills.name: Pose-graph optimization
skills.description: Formulate robot poses and relative measurements as a graph and solve it by nonlinear least squares to distribute accumulated drift.

skills.name: Detect loop closures and recognize places
skills.description: Recognize a previously visited place from scan or image signatures, verify the match geometrically, and add the constraint to the pose graph to correct drift.

skills.name: Simultaneous localization and mapping
skills.description: Explain how SLAM jointly estimates robot trajectory and map through front-end matching and back-end optimization, and identify its failure modes in practice.

skills.name: Map a building with 2D lidar SLAM
skills.description: Configure and run a ROS 2 lidar SLAM package on the wheeled base, drive a mapping run, save and reuse the map, and switch to localization mode.

skills.name: Visual SLAM with cameras
skills.description: Run a feature-based visual or RGB-D SLAM system, interpret its keyframes and map points, and diagnose tracking loss from blur, texture or lighting.

skills.name: Attach object and place labels to a map
skills.description: Anchor detected objects and named places in the map frame, merge repeated observations, and expire stale entries so the robot can answer where things are.

skills.name: Timestamp sources and clock domains
skills.description: Distinguish exposure, hardware, driver and receive timestamps, identify clock domains on a robot, and know when NTP, PTP or hardware triggering is needed.

skills.name: Synchronize and interpolate sensor messages
skills.description: Pair messages from different sensors with exact or approximate time policies, interpolate poses to a measurement's timestamp, and handle out-of-order data.

skills.name: Fuse IMU and wheel odometry with an EKF
skills.description: Configure an extended Kalman filter to fuse wheel odometry and IMU orientation and rate into a smooth base pose estimate, and validate it on a closed loop.

skills.name: Tune fusion covariances from data
skills.description: Set process and measurement covariances from measured sensor noise, then refine them by checking innovation statistics and consistency on recorded data.

skills.name: Calibrate camera-IMU extrinsics and time offset
skills.description: Estimate the rotation, translation and time offset between a camera and IMU with a calibration target and excitation motion, and validate the result.

skills.name: Privacy and consent for robot cameras and microphones
skills.description: Design data handling for robot cameras and microphones: on-device processing, retention limits, visible recording indicators and consent before storing identities.

skills.name: Detect faces in camera images
skills.description: Run a neural face detector on live video, filter by size and confidence, and measure detection range and failure under pose and lighting changes.

skills.name: Facial landmarks and head pose
skills.description: Detect facial landmarks and estimate head yaw, pitch and roll by fitting a 3D face model with PnP, and report confidence of the estimate.

skills.name: Recognize enrolled people with consent
skills.description: Enroll consenting people with face embeddings, match new faces against a threshold, measure false accept and reject rates, and support deletion on request.

skills.name: Detect and track people and faces
skills.description: Locate nearby people in 3D from detections, keypoints and depth, and keep stable identities for them and their faces over time with a motion model.

skills.name: Recognize gestures from body and hand keypoints
skills.description: Detect hand landmarks and classify gestures such as waving, pointing and stop from body and hand keypoint sequences, measuring false triggers.

skills.name: Estimate a person's gaze direction
skills.description: Estimate where a person is looking from head pose and eye appearance, and judge whether they are looking at the robot within an angular tolerance.

skills.name: Detect who is addressing the robot
skills.description: Fuse gaze, distance, body orientation and voice direction to decide which person is engaging the robot and when they start or stop.

skills.name: Microphones and digital audio sampling
skills.description: Compare MEMS and electret microphones by sensitivity and self-noise, choose sample rate and bit depth for speech, and compute audio data rates.

skills.name: Capture audio on Linux
skills.description: Capture multichannel audio with ALSA or PipeWire, select devices, set buffer sizes, and measure capture latency and dropouts.

skills.name: Discrete Fourier transform and spectra
skills.description: Compute a signal's spectrum with the FFT, relate bin spacing to sample rate and length, and identify tones and noise in recorded audio.

skills.name: Short-time Fourier transform and spectrograms
skills.description: Compute spectrograms with windowed STFT and mel scaling, and choose window length to trade time against frequency resolution.

skills.name: Voice activity detection
skills.description: Detect speech segments with an energy-based detector and a neural detector, set hangover times, and measure missed speech and false triggers in noise.

skills.name: Suppress background noise in speech
skills.description: Apply spectral subtraction and a neural noise suppressor to speech, and evaluate improvement in transcription accuracy rather than only listening quality.

skills.name: Cancel the robot's own voice with echo cancellation
skills.description: Use the playback signal as reference for an adaptive echo canceller so the robot hears users while speaking, and test barge-in performance.

skills.name: Microphone array geometry and time differences
skills.description: Compute time differences of arrival for a source direction given array geometry, and relate microphone spacing to spatial aliasing frequency.

skills.name: Estimate time delay with GCC-PHAT
skills.description: Estimate the delay between two microphone signals with phase-transform weighted cross-correlation, and convert delays to a direction of arrival.

skills.name: Delay-and-sum beamforming
skills.description: Steer a microphone array toward a talker with delay-and-sum beamforming, compute the beam pattern, and measure the signal-to-noise gain.

skills.name: Microphone array capture and sound localization
skills.description: Capture a multichannel array on the robot, localize and track active talkers by direction, and output an enhanced beamformed channel for speech recognition.

skills.name: Tactile sensing technologies
skills.description: Compare resistive, capacitive, piezoresistive, barometric and magnetic tactile sensors by sensitivity, hysteresis, durability and wiring cost for robot hands.

skills.name: Read and calibrate a force-sensing resistor
skills.description: Read a force-sensing resistor through a voltage divider, calibrate it against known forces, and quantify its hysteresis and drift.

skills.name: Scan a tactile array and locate contact
skills.description: Scan a multiplexed grid of taxels, compute total force and contact centroid, and visualize pressure distribution across a fingertip or palm.

skills.name: Detect contact and incipient slip
skills.description: Detect contact onset and incipient slip from tactile and force signals using thresholds and high-frequency vibration features, and signal the grasp controller.

skills.name: Sense foot contact and ground reaction
skills.description: Detect foot touchdown and estimate ground reaction force and centre of pressure from foot pressure sensors or ankle force-torque sensing.

skills.name: Budget latency through a perception pipeline
skills.description: Instrument each stage from capture to published result, build a latency and throughput budget, and find the stage that limits reaction time.

skills.name: Optimize and profile vision models on edge hardware
skills.description: Export a vision model to an optimized runtime with FP16 or INT8 quantization, then verify accuracy loss, speedup and resource use on the robot computer.

skills.name: Monitor sensor health and degrade safely
skills.description: Detect stale, frozen, saturated or implausible sensor streams at runtime and switch the robot to a safe degraded behaviour with a clear report.

skills.name: Regression-test perception with recorded data
skills.description: Record representative sensor logs with ground truth, replay them through the perception stack after each change, and track metrics over versions.

skills.name: Design a humanoid sensor suite
skills.description: Place cameras, depth sensors, lidar, microphones and tactile sensors on a humanoid to cover navigation, manipulation and interaction with minimal blind spots.

skills.name: Integrate perception into a shared world model
skills.description: Combine map, objects, people and audio events into one time-stamped world model that planners and dialogue can query, with confidence and staleness for each item.

skills.name: Resolve a force along a line in 3D
skills.description: Write a force acting along a cable or link as magnitude times a unit vector built from two point coordinates, and add concurrent 3D forces by components.

skills.name: Moment of a force as a cross product
skills.description: Compute the moment of a 3D force about a point as r cross F using the determinant form, and interpret its direction with the right-hand rule.

skills.name: Moment of a force about a specified axis
skills.description: Find the component of a moment along a given axis, such as a joint axis, using the scalar triple product with the axis unit vector.

skills.name: Couple moments as free vectors in 3D
skills.description: Represent a couple as a free moment vector independent of reference point, and add several couples acting in different planes by vector components.

skills.name: Reduce a 3D force system to a force and couple
skills.description: Replace any set of forces and couples with one resultant force and one resultant couple at a chosen point, the basis of wrench representation.

skills.name: Reactions of 3D supports and connections
skills.description: Identify the force and couple reactions supplied by ball-and-socket joints, hinges, journal bearings, thrust bearings and fixed supports in three dimensions.

skills.name: Equilibrium of a rigid body in 3D
skills.description: Write and solve the six scalar equilibrium equations for a rigid body, choosing moment axes that eliminate unknown reactions, for shafts and brackets.

skills.name: Forces in multi-member frames and machines
skills.description: Disassemble a linkage, gripper or clamp into member free-body diagrams and solve pin forces and the mechanical advantage between input and output.

skills.name: Resultant of a distributed load
skills.description: Replace a distributed line load such as self-weight or pressure with an equivalent point force by integrating its intensity and locating its centroid.

skills.name: Centroid of an area by integration
skills.description: Locate the centroid of a planar shape bounded by curves by integrating first moments of area over vertical or horizontal strips.

skills.name: Center of mass of a composite body
skills.description: Compute the 3D center of mass of an assembly of standard shapes, treating holes and cutouts as negative mass, and check it against CAD values.

skills.name: Principle of virtual work for mechanism statics
skills.description: Relate input torque to output force in a one-degree-of-freedom mechanism by setting total virtual work to zero for a compatible virtual displacement.

skills.name: Angle of friction and the friction cone
skills.description: Express the static friction limit as an angle whose tangent is the coefficient, and test whether a total contact reaction lies inside the friction cone.

skills.name: Tipping versus slipping of a pushed body
skills.description: Determine whether a block or robot pushed sideways will slide or tip first by comparing the friction limit with the moment balance about the edge.

skills.name: Friction in wedges and power screws
skills.description: Analyze a wedge with friction on several faces and treat a square-thread screw as a wrapped wedge to find raising, lowering and self-locking torques.

skills.name: Derive belt friction from a differential element
skills.description: Derive the exponential tension ratio for a flat belt or rope wrapped on a drum by balancing forces on a small arc element and separating variables.

skills.name: Rolling resistance of wheels
skills.description: Model rolling resistance as a forward shift of the normal force or a coefficient times load, and compute the drive torque needed to overcome it.

skills.name: Friction torque in pivots, collars and journals
skills.description: Integrate friction over a flat collar or disk clutch and use the friction circle for a journal bearing to find the resisting torque in a joint.

skills.name: Angular velocity and acceleration as vectors
skills.description: Represent angular velocity and angular acceleration as vectors along the rotation axis by the right-hand rule and add angular velocities of nested rotations.

skills.name: Point velocity from omega cross r
skills.description: Compute the velocity of any point on a body rotating about a fixed axis in 3D as the cross product of angular velocity with the position vector.

skills.name: Tangential and centripetal acceleration of a rotating point
skills.description: Split the acceleration of a point on a rotating body into alpha cross r and omega cross omega cross r, and evaluate both for an accelerating link.

skills.name: Relative velocity of two points on a rigid body
skills.description: Relate velocities of two points on a body in planar motion with v_B equals v_A plus omega cross r_B/A, and solve simple linkage velocities.

skills.name: Relative acceleration of two points on a rigid body
skills.description: Relate accelerations of two points on a body in general planar motion, including tangential and centripetal relative terms, to analyze links and wheels.

skills.name: Accelerations of a rolling wheel
skills.description: Apply the no-slip constraint to relate center acceleration and angular acceleration of a wheel, and show the contact point accelerates toward the center.

skills.name: Moment of inertia as an integral
skills.description: Set up the moment of inertia of a continuous body as the integral of squared distance times mass element, writing dm from linear, areal or volume density.

skills.name: Moment of inertia of a slender rod
skills.description: Integrate to obtain the moment of inertia of a uniform slender rod about its center and about one end, and compare the two results.

skills.name: Moment of inertia of a ring, disk and annulus
skills.description: Derive the axial moment of inertia of a thin ring, a solid disk and an annular disk by integrating concentric rings, as for wheels and rotors.

skills.name: Perpendicular-axis theorem for flat plates
skills.description: Use the perpendicular-axis theorem to get the in-plane moments of inertia of a thin lamina, such as a disk about a diameter, from its polar moment.

skills.name: Moment of inertia of solid and hollow cylinders
skills.description: Compute the moment of inertia of solid and thick-walled cylinders about their axis and about a transverse centroidal axis, as for motors and tubular links.

skills.name: Moment of inertia of a sphere and spherical shell
skills.description: Integrate thin disks or shells to obtain the moment of inertia of a solid sphere and a thin spherical shell about a diameter.

skills.name: Moment of inertia of a rectangular plate and block
skills.description: Compute the centroidal moments of inertia of a rectangular plate and a rectangular block about each axis, the usual approximation for robot links and batteries.

skills.name: Radius of gyration
skills.description: Convert between moment of inertia and radius of gyration, and use tabulated radii of gyration to estimate inertia of irregular parts.

skills.name: Moment of inertia of a composite body
skills.description: Combine standard-shape inertias with the parallel-axis theorem, subtracting holes, to find the inertia of a link with motor and payload about a joint axis.

skills.name: Products of inertia
skills.description: Compute products of inertia by integration or from symmetry, and state when they vanish for bodies with planes of symmetry.

skills.name: Moment of inertia about an arbitrary axis
skills.description: Assemble the 3 by 3 inertia matrix from moments and products, and compute the inertia about any unit axis as the quadratic form n transpose I n.

skills.name: Principal moments and axes of inertia
skills.description: Find principal moments and axes of a rigid body as eigenvalues and eigenvectors of its symmetric inertia matrix, and explain why principal axes are orthogonal.

skills.name: Hanging masses over a pulley with inertia
skills.description: Solve accelerations and unequal rope tensions for masses connected over a pulley whose moment of inertia is not negligible.

skills.name: Work done by a variable torque
skills.description: Compute rotational work as the integral of torque over angle, including spring and gravity torques, and relate it to the change in rotational kinetic energy.

skills.name: Energy of rolling bodies
skills.description: Combine translational and rotational kinetic energy for a rolling wheel or cylinder and use energy conservation to find speed after descending a ramp.

skills.name: Forces on an accelerating rolling wheel
skills.description: Apply force and moment equations to a driven or braked wheel, find the friction force required for rolling, and check it against the slip limit.

skills.name: Equations of general planar rigid-body motion
skills.description: Write sum of forces equals mass times center-of-mass acceleration and sum of moments about the center equals I alpha for a body in general planar motion.

skills.name: Pivot reactions on a swinging link
skills.description: Find the pivot reaction forces on a link rotating about a fixed joint, such as a rod released from horizontal, using tangential and normal center-of-mass acceleration.

skills.name: Free-body diagrams for linked rigid bodies
skills.description: Draw separate dynamic free-body diagrams for connected bodies, such as a cart with a pendulum or a two-link arm, and solve joint forces with accelerations.

skills.name: Equivalent inertia of a drive by energy equivalence
skills.description: Derive the equivalent inertia at the motor shaft of a multi-stage gear train, belt or screw driving rotating and translating masses by equating kinetic energies.

skills.name: Equation of motion of a geared drive
skills.description: Write the single-axis equation of motion of a motor driving a load through a gear ratio, referring load torque, friction and efficiency to the motor shaft.

skills.name: Angular momentum of particles and rigid bodies
skills.description: Compute angular momentum as r cross p for particles and as the inertia matrix times angular velocity for a rigid body, noting when L is not parallel to omega.

skills.name: Angular impulse and momentum change
skills.description: Relate the time integral of torque to the change in angular momentum, and find spin-up time or final speed of a rotor under a given torque history.

skills.name: Reaction torque on the robot body
skills.description: Explain and calculate the equal and opposite torque a motor exerts on its mount when accelerating a load, as in reaction wheels and free-floating bases.

skills.name: Gyroscopic precession and gyroscopic torque
skills.description: Calculate the steady precession rate of a spinning rotor under gravity and the gyroscopic torque on bearings when a spinning rotor is turned about another axis.

skills.name: Time derivative of a vector in a rotating frame
skills.description: Apply the transport theorem, inertial derivative equals body-frame derivative plus omega cross the vector, to velocities, momentum and angular momentum.

skills.name: Coefficient of restitution
skills.description: Define the coefficient of restitution from relative separation and approach speeds, solve partially elastic 1D impacts and measure it from bounce heights.

skills.name: Impact on a pivoted rigid body
skills.description: Solve an impact between a particle and a pivoted link, using conservation of angular momentum about the pivot together with the restitution condition.

skills.name: Center of percussion
skills.description: Locate the point on a pivoted link where an impact produces no impulsive pivot reaction, and use it to reduce shock loads on joints.

skills.name: Peak impact force from contact stiffness
skills.description: Estimate peak contact force and duration of an impact by modeling the contact as a spring, giving force equal to speed times the square root of stiffness times mass.

skills.name: Effective mass of an arm at a contact point
skills.description: Compute the effective mass a geared robot link presents at a contact point from its total reflected inertia and lever arm, and its effect on impact force.

skills.name: Generalized coordinates and holonomic constraints
skills.description: Count degrees of freedom of a constrained mechanical system, choose independent generalized coordinates and write holonomic constraint equations that eliminate dependent ones.

skills.name: Kinetic energy in generalized coordinates
skills.description: Express the kinetic energy of a system of particles and rigid bodies in terms of generalized coordinates and their rates using the chain rule.

skills.name: Equation of motion of a pendulum by Lagrange
skills.description: Form the Lagrangian of a simple and a physical pendulum, apply the Euler-Lagrange equation and recover the familiar nonlinear equation of motion.

skills.name: Equations of motion of a cart-pole by Lagrange
skills.description: Derive the two coupled nonlinear equations of a pendulum on a horizontally driven cart using Lagrange equations with a generalized input force.

skills.name: Equations of motion of a double pendulum
skills.description: Derive the coupled equations of a planar double pendulum with Lagrange equations and identify mass-matrix, Coriolis and gravity terms.

skills.name: Generalized forces from applied forces and torques
skills.description: Compute the generalized force for each coordinate from applied joint torques, external forces and viscous friction using virtual work.

skills.name: Solve the simple harmonic oscillator equation
skills.description: Solve x double-dot plus omega squared x equals zero and find amplitude and phase from initial position and velocity.

skills.name: Energy in simple harmonic motion
skills.description: Track the exchange of kinetic and potential energy in an oscillator and find maximum speed and acceleration from amplitude and natural frequency.

skills.name: Equivalent stiffness of springs in series and parallel
skills.description: Combine linear and torsional springs in series and parallel into one equivalent stiffness and identify which arrangement a mechanism creates.

skills.name: Natural frequency from static deflection
skills.description: Show that gravity shifts but does not change a vertical oscillator, and estimate natural frequency directly from static deflection under self-weight.

skills.name: Torsional spring and inertia oscillator
skills.description: Find the natural frequency of a rotor on a torsionally flexible shaft from torsional stiffness and moment of inertia.

skills.name: Physical pendulum period
skills.description: Calculate the small-oscillation period of a rigid body swinging about a pivot from its mass, center-of-mass distance and moment of inertia about the pivot.

skills.name: Measure moment of inertia by oscillation
skills.description: Measure the moment of inertia of a robot link or rotor by timing compound-pendulum, bifilar or torsional oscillations and propagating timing uncertainty.

skills.name: Energy method for natural frequency
skills.description: Derive the natural frequency of a single-degree-of-freedom system from its kinetic and potential energy, including spring mass and lever arms.

skills.name: Damping ratio and natural frequency from m, c and k
skills.description: Compute undamped natural frequency, critical damping coefficient and damping ratio of a mass-spring-damper and relate them to its characteristic roots.

skills.name: Underdamped free response
skills.description: Write the underdamped free response as a decaying sinusoid, compute the damped natural frequency and the exponential envelope from initial conditions.

skills.name: Logarithmic decrement
skills.description: Estimate damping ratio from the ratio of successive peaks in measured ring-down data using the logarithmic decrement.

skills.name: Quality factor and energy loss per cycle
skills.description: Relate quality factor to damping ratio, energy dissipated per cycle and resonance bandwidth for a lightly damped oscillator.

skills.name: Steady-state response to harmonic forcing
skills.description: Find the steady-state amplitude and phase lag of a damped oscillator driven by a sinusoidal force, and plot the magnification factor against frequency ratio.

skills.name: Frequency response of a mass-spring-damper
skills.description: Derive the transfer function from force to displacement of a mass-spring-damper, draw its Bode magnitude and phase, and locate the resonant peak.

skills.name: Base excitation and transmissibility
skills.description: Compute displacement and force transmissibility for a mass on a spring and damper whose base vibrates, and find where transmissibility drops below one.

skills.name: Vibration isolation design
skills.description: Choose isolator stiffness and damping so the excitation frequency exceeds the square root of two times natural frequency, for camera, IMU and motor mounts.

skills.name: Equations of motion of a two-degree-of-freedom system
skills.description: Write the coupled equations of two masses connected by springs in mass and stiffness matrix form, M x double-dot plus K x equals zero.

skills.name: Natural frequencies and mode shapes
skills.description: Find the natural frequencies and mode shapes of a two-degree-of-freedom system by solving det of K minus omega squared M equals zero.

skills.name: Modes of a two-inertia torsional system
skills.description: Show that a motor and load joined by a flexible shaft have a zero-frequency rigid mode and one torsional mode, and compute that resonance frequency.

skills.name: First bending frequency of a cantilever
skills.description: Estimate the first bending natural frequency of a cantilever beam with and without a tip mass using the standard mode constant and an equivalent spring.

skills.name: Equation of motion of an inverted pendulum
skills.description: Derive the nonlinear equation of a rigid inverted pendulum pivoted at its base with an applied pivot torque and identify its upright equilibrium.

skills.name: Linearize the inverted pendulum about upright
skills.description: Linearize the inverted pendulum for small tilt, find its real unstable root square root of g over l, and compute the time for a tilt to grow.

skills.name: Linear state-space model of a cart-pole
skills.description: Linearize the cart-pole equations about the upright equilibrium and write the four-state linear model with cart force as input.

skills.name: Balancing by accelerating the support
skills.description: Calculate the horizontal support acceleration needed to hold a tall body at a given lean angle, the physics behind wheeled balancing and leaning while braking.

skills.name: Center-of-mass acceleration and ground reaction
skills.description: Relate total ground reaction force to center-of-mass acceleration and the moment balance about the center of mass to the location of the center of pressure.

skills.name: Inertial forces in a linearly accelerating frame
skills.description: Analyze objects in an accelerating frame, such as a cup on a braking robot tray, by adding a fictitious force equal to minus mass times frame acceleration.

skills.name: Centrifugal force in a rotating frame
skills.description: Describe a body at rest in a rotating frame using centrifugal force and compare it with the centripetal description in the inertial frame.

skills.name: Coriolis acceleration in a rotating frame
skills.description: Compute the Coriolis term minus two omega cross v for a body moving within a rotating frame, such as a gripper sliding along a turning arm.

skills.name: What an accelerometer measures
skills.description: Explain that an accelerometer reads specific force, acceleration minus gravity, and compute extra centripetal and tangential readings from an off-center mounting.

skills.name: Heat capacity of a multi-material part
skills.description: Sum mass times specific heat for copper, steel, aluminum and plastic parts to find the lumped heat capacity of a motor or electronics module.

skills.name: Efficiency losses appear as heat
skills.description: Compute dissipated heat from input power and efficiency for motors, regulators and gearboxes, recognizing that every watt not delivered as useful work ends up warming the robot.

skills.name: Temperature and component lifetime
skills.description: Apply an Arrhenius acceleration factor and the rule of thumb that lifetime halves per ten-degree rise to estimate capacitor, battery and lubricant life at operating temperature.

skills.name: Air stored in a pneumatic reservoir
skills.description: Use the ideal gas law with absolute pressures to compute the mass of stored air and the free-air volume a tank can deliver between two gauge pressures.

skills.name: Conduction thermal resistance of a slab
skills.description: Express steady conduction through a wall, pad or bracket as a thermal resistance equal to thickness over conductivity times area, in kelvin per watt.

skills.name: Radial conduction through a cylindrical shell
skills.description: Derive and apply the logarithmic thermal resistance of a cylindrical shell for heat flowing outward through motor housings, winding insulation and pipe walls.

skills.name: Thermal contact resistance at clamped joints
skills.description: Explain how surface roughness, flatness and clamping pressure create contact resistance at bolted interfaces, and estimate it from interface conductance data.

skills.name: Choose a thermal interface material
skills.description: Compare thermal paste, gap pads, phase-change films and adhesives by conductivity, bond-line thickness and compliance, and compute the resulting interface resistance.

skills.name: Junction-to-ambient resistance chain from datasheets
skills.description: Combine junction-to-case, case-to-sink and sink-to-ambient resistances from datasheets in series and compute junction temperature for a given dissipation.

skills.name: Heat spreading through PCB copper and thermal vias
skills.description: Calculate the conduction resistance of copper pours and arrays of plated thermal vias, and judge how much they lower a component's temperature.

skills.name: Newton's law of cooling and convection resistance
skills.description: Apply heat flow equals h times area times temperature difference, convert it to a convection resistance, and recall typical h values for still air, fans and liquids.

skills.name: Natural convection from a heated plate
skills.description: Estimate a natural-convection coefficient for a vertical heated surface from a simplified correlation, and explain how orientation and buoyant plumes affect cooling.

skills.name: Forced convection and the Nusselt number
skills.description: Use a Nusselt-number correlation in Reynolds number to estimate the heat transfer coefficient for air blown over a plate or through a channel.

skills.name: How heatsink fins add cooling area
skills.description: Explain how fins raise convective area, why fins spaced too closely choke airflow, and why fins in still air need wider spacing than fins under a fan.

skills.name: Fin efficiency of a straight fin
skills.description: Calculate the efficiency of a straight rectangular fin from its fin parameter and length, and explain why long thin fins add little cooling.

skills.name: Read heatsink resistance versus airflow curves
skills.description: Read a heatsink's sink-to-ambient resistance at a given airflow or orientation from a datasheet curve and select a sink that meets a junction temperature limit.

skills.name: Air temperature rise from absorbed heat
skills.description: Compute the outlet air temperature rise when a mass flow of air absorbs a known heat load, using heat equals mass flow times specific heat times temperature rise.

skills.name: Size ventilation airflow for an enclosure
skills.description: Find the volume flow in liters per second or CFM needed to hold enclosure air within an allowed rise, and place inlets and outlets so air sweeps hot parts.

skills.name: Fan curve and system impedance operating point
skills.description: Intersect a fan's pressure-flow curve with an enclosure's quadratic impedance curve to find delivered airflow, and see why free-air ratings overstate real flow.

skills.name: Emissivity of real surfaces
skills.description: Compare emissivities of bare aluminum, anodized parts, paint and plastics, and explain why surface finish matters more than color for infrared radiation.

skills.name: Linearized radiation heat transfer coefficient
skills.description: Linearize net radiation into an equivalent coefficient proportional to emissivity times absolute temperature cubed, and add it in parallel with convection.

skills.name: Blackbody spectrum and Wien's displacement law
skills.description: Use Wien's law to find the peak emission wavelength of a body at a given temperature, explaining why warm robot parts glow in long-wave infrared.

skills.name: Infrared thermometer and thermal camera readings
skills.description: Explain how infrared thermometers infer temperature, and correct or avoid errors from wrong emissivity settings and reflective metal surfaces when checking motors.

skills.name: Thermal time constant of a lumped body
skills.description: Compute a thermal time constant as thermal resistance times heat capacity and use it to judge how quickly a motor or heatsink approaches steady temperature.

skills.name: Exponential heating and cooling curves
skills.description: Solve the first-order lumped thermal model for a step in power and predict temperature at any time during heating and after the load is removed.

skills.name: Time to reach a temperature limit under overload
skills.description: Solve the exponential heating curve with a natural logarithm to find how long an overloaded joint can run before reaching its winding limit.

skills.name: Copper resistance rise with temperature
skills.description: Use copper's temperature coefficient of about 0.39 percent per kelvin to predict winding resistance and copper loss at elevated temperature.

skills.name: Infer winding temperature from resistance change
skills.description: Measure cold and hot winding resistance and invert the copper temperature coefficient to estimate average winding temperature without an embedded sensor.

skills.name: Average heating under fast duty cycles
skills.description: Explain why a duty cycle much shorter than the thermal time constant heats a winding according to mean squared current, and compute that average dissipation.

skills.name: Read and apply a thermal derating curve
skills.description: Read a power or current derating curve versus ambient temperature, and compute allowed dissipation from maximum junction temperature and the thermal resistance chain.

skills.name: Static, dynamic and total pressure
skills.description: Distinguish static, dynamic and total pressure, compute dynamic pressure from air speed, and read a pitot tube or fan static-pressure specification.

skills.name: Dynamic and kinematic viscosity
skills.description: Relate shear stress to velocity gradient through dynamic viscosity, convert to kinematic viscosity, and compare air, water and oils at different temperatures.

skills.name: Darcy-Weisbach pressure drop in tubes and ducts
skills.description: Calculate friction pressure drop with Darcy-Weisbach, using hydraulic diameter for rectangular ducts and a laminar or turbulent friction factor from Reynolds number.

skills.name: Minor losses at bends, grilles and filters
skills.description: Add loss coefficients for bends, sudden expansions, vent grilles and dust filters, each multiplying dynamic pressure, to total an air path's pressure drop.

skills.name: Enclosure airflow impedance curve
skills.description: Build a system impedance curve for an enclosure, pressure drop proportional to flow squared, from component losses or a single measured point.

skills.name: Holding force from a pressure difference
skills.description: Compute the holding force of a suction cup or vacuum pad from absolute pressure difference and effective area, including the atmospheric ceiling on vacuum force.

skills.name: Quadratic drag force and drag coefficient
skills.description: Calculate aerodynamic drag from dynamic pressure, frontal area and drag coefficient, and show it is negligible for a walking-speed robot but matters for fans and propellers.

skills.name: Traveling sinusoidal wave functions
skills.description: Write and evaluate a traveling wave as amplitude times sine of kx minus omega t, relating wave number and angular frequency to wavelength, period and speed.

skills.name: The one-dimensional wave equation
skills.description: Derive the wave equation for a taut string from Newton's second law, verify that traveling sinusoids solve it, and find speed as root of tension over linear density.

skills.name: Wave power and intensity
skills.description: Define intensity as power per unit area, show that it scales with amplitude squared, and compute intensity from source power over a given area.

skills.name: Reflection and transmission at an impedance boundary
skills.description: Calculate reflected and transmitted fractions of a wave at a boundary between media of different characteristic impedance, such as air to solid or air to water.

skills.name: Speed of sound and its temperature dependence
skills.description: Compute the speed of sound in air from absolute temperature and compare it with speeds in water and solids, explaining why warm air carries sound faster.

skills.name: Standing waves in open and closed tubes
skills.description: Calculate resonant frequencies of tubes open at both ends or closed at one end, and recognize such resonances in ducts, vents and speaker ports.

skills.name: Sound pressure level from RMS pressure
skills.description: Convert RMS acoustic pressure to sound pressure level in decibels relative to 20 micropascals, using 20 log for pressure versus 10 log for intensity.

skills.name: Adding incoherent sources in decibels
skills.description: Combine the levels of independent noise sources by summing their intensities, and show that doubling identical sources adds about three decibels.

skills.name: Inverse-square spreading of sound
skills.description: Predict sound level at a new distance from a point source using spherical spreading, losing about six decibels per doubling of distance in free field.

skills.name: Reverberation time with Sabine's formula
skills.description: Total surface absorption from frequency-dependent absorption coefficients, estimate reverberation time with Sabine's formula, and explain how long reverberation smears speech.

skills.name: Room modes, early reflections and critical distance
skills.description: Describe low-frequency room modes, early reflections and the critical distance where direct and reverberant sound are equal, and their effect on robot hearing.

skills.name: White, pink and tonal noise spectra
skills.description: Distinguish white, pink and tonal noise by spectral shape, and identify motor whine, fan tones and broadband airflow noise on a spectrum plot.

skills.name: A-weighting and C-weighting of sound levels
skills.description: Group a spectrum into octave bands, apply A and C weighting corrections to report dBA and dBC, and explain why A-weighting approximates human hearing.

skills.name: Vibration isolation and structure-borne noise
skills.description: Compute transmissibility of a spring-damper mount versus frequency ratio and choose isolators that keep motor and fan vibration from radiating through the shell.

skills.name: Doppler shift of an echo from a moving target
skills.description: Compute the two-way Doppler shift of sound reflected from a moving object and use it to infer the object's approach speed.

skills.name: Microphone transduction principles
skills.description: Explain how condenser, MEMS, dynamic and piezoelectric microphones convert pressure into voltage, and how pressure and pressure-gradient designs differ.

skills.name: Microphone sensitivity, self-noise and SNR
skills.description: Convert sensitivity in dBV per pascal or dBFS to output level at a given SPL, and compute signal-to-noise ratio from equivalent self-noise.

skills.name: Microphone polar patterns and directivity
